tables.title: [Questions Asked on the Census Blank Concerning Each Individual]
tables.rationale: Textual list of eleven questions on the census blank, with no quantities. It is a census instrument, not a statistical series. No existing tag covers census methodology.
review_questions: Propose a tag for census methods or enumeration procedures.

tables.title: [Items Reported by the Census Boards]
tables.rationale: Textual list of items reported by the census boards, with no figures. No tag covers census content or procedure.
review_questions: Propose a tag for census methods or enumeration procedures.

tables.title: [Titles of the Executive Council of the Gild of the Blind]
tables.rationale: List of court-style titles of the executive council of the Gild of the Blind; a textual roster of an entertainers' guild. No fitting tag for guilds of the blind or storytellers.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for guilds or occupational societies be added?

tables.title: Figure 18: Banks - Markets - Factories (Map Legend)
tables.rationale: Map legend counting markets by type, banks and factories in Peking; markets are the dominant content.
review_questions: Banks and factories are also counted; is a broader urban commercial inventory tag needed?

tables.title: Figure 20: Hotels (Map Legend)
tables.rationale: Map legend naming hotels, inns, restaurants and bars; no counts are printed, so it is a locational legend. Hotels and inns fit tourism only loosely, and restaurants and bars are not tourism, so no detailed tag is assigned.
review_questions: Should a hospitality or accommodation tag be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: [Gild Halls Built by the Provinces]
tables.rationale: Counts of provincial gild halls built in Peking by province of origin. The subject is native-place guilds and their halls, which no existing tag covers; the high-level topic is the closest fit.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for guilds or native-place associations?

tables.title: [Inmates of the Industrial Home, Door of Hope and Women's Reformatory, August 1919]
tables.rationale: Inmate counts at a women's industrial home, rescue home (Door of Hope) and women's reformatory. These are rescue institutions for women, and no tag covers rescue homes specifically.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for rescue homes or women's protection institutions?

tables.title: [Operating Expenses of the Police Chou Ch'ang, 1915]
tables.rationale: Operating expenses of the police gruel kitchens (chou ch'ang) in 1915. The kitchens are charitable food relief, but no tag fits a feeding-kitchen budget.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for soup or gruel kitchens?

tables.title: [Police Chou Ch'ang Receipts by Source, 1915]
tables.rationale: Receipts of the police gruel kitchens by source in 1915. The printed total does not reconcile with the parts, but it is kept as printed.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for soup or gruel kitchens?

tables.title: Figure 24: Church Survey Card
tables.rationale: Blank bilingual church survey card; its content is a list of form fields with no quantities. Subject is a household and church-membership survey instrument.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for survey instruments or forms; propose one.

tables.title: Figure 32: Incomes
tables.rationale: Family income-group percentages for church families in three churches. No tag fits family income distribution of a church community.
review_questions: Propose a tag for income distribution of families.

tables.title: Figure 36: Church Relationships
tables.rationale: Percentages of church relationship, attendance, contributors and voluntary workers across three churches.
review_questions: Propose a tag for church membership participation.

tables.title: Industrial Department Persons Employed
tables.rationale: Persons employed in departments of the Russian Orthodox Mission's industrial department (printing, soap, mill, etc.).
review_questions: Propose a tag for mission-run industrial enterprises.

tables.title: Higher Primary Curriculum
tables.rationale: Weekly hours per subject in the higher primary curriculum. No existing tag covers curricula.
review_questions: Propose a vocabulary term for school curricula.

tables.title: Middle School Curriculum
tables.rationale: Weekly hours per subject in the middle school course by year and sex; middle schools are secondary education.
review_questions: Propose a vocabulary term for school curricula.

tables.title: Graduates of Schools in Peking Under the National Board of Education
tables.rationale: Graduates by school type, mostly normal, law, technical and university graduates.
review_questions: Is there a better tag for graduates and degrees?

tables.title: Lecture Halls
tables.rationale: Seating capacity of Peking lecture halls (popular lecture stations); adult or social education but no exact tag fits.
review_questions: Should a tag for popular lecture halls or social education be added? literacy-and-adult-education was judged not precise enough.

tables.title: Number and Character of Average Daily Attendance
tables.rationale: Average daily attendance at lecture halls with marks for classes of attendees; quantitative, but no exact tag fits.
review_questions: Printed total 1,005 does not match the sum of the figures; kept as printed. Missing tag for popular lecture halls or social education.

tables.title: Lecture Halls (Continued): Subjects Discussed
tables.rationale: Counts of lectures by subject grouped by theme (politics, morality, science, hygiene, social reform) delivered in lecture halls; no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for popular lecture halls or social education.

tables.title: Lecture Halls (Continued): Monthly Budgets
tables.rationale: Monthly running expenses of each lecture hall; education funding but no specific tag for lecture-hall budgets.
review_questions: education-finance was not applied as the table concerns popular lecture halls rather than schools; confirm or propose a social-education tag.

tables.title: Social Education: 1916 Statistics for Metropoliatn District
tables.rationale: 1916 social-education statistics comparing the Metropolitan District and the whole country, covering libraries, museums, newspaper rooms, lecture halls and societies. Libraries are the dominant measured component.
review_questions: Social education (lecture halls, societies) has no specific tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Writers Whose Thought Could Be Translated for the New Thought Movement]
tables.rationale: A list of Western writers to be translated for the New Thought Movement. Purely textual, with no quantities.
review_questions: No tag fits an intellectual movement or reading list; consider a vocabulary term for intellectual movements.

tables.title: Gild Membership
tables.rationale: Membership of Peking trade gilds split into employers, workers and apprentices, with a worker-to-apprentice ratio. Organisation of workers by trade.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for guilds be added?

tables.title: Membership of the Barbers Gild
tables.rationale: Membership of the Barbers Gild by class: store-keepers, workers, itinerant barbers and apprentices.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for guilds be added?

tables.title: Report of the Precious Stone Dealers Gild: Income and Expenses
tables.rationale: Income and expense statement of the Precious Stone Dealers Gild for 1911-1912, a business association's accounts.
review_questions: Gild/association accounts are not covered by a tag; business-associations was not selected because the table is mainly a financial statement.

tables.title: Income and Expense of the Boot Gild of Peking: List of the Expenses and Receipts
tables.rationale: Receipts and expenditures of the Boot Gild for its patron-god sacrifice in 1918, including play, feast and incense costs.
review_questions: No tag fits gild ritual finance; consider a term for guild accounts.

tables.title: [Officers of the Lu Pan Industrial Union]
tables.rationale: Number of each type of officer in the Lu Pan Industrial Union's regulations; an organisational listing with counts.
review_questions: No tag for the organisation of a guild or union; trade-unions was not assigned because the union's labour-representation role is not established.

tables.title: Books from Which Story Tellers Take Their Stories
tables.rationale: A list of book titles from which professional story tellers draw their stories. The content is textual and concerns recreation and performance.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no tag for storytelling or traditional oral performance; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Temple Markets
tables.rationale: Maps each day of the Chinese month to the temple holding its market. The content is textual scheduling and covers recreation and commerce at temples.
review_questions: No tag fits temple markets or fairs; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Peking Billiard Rooms
tables.rationale: Inventory of billiard rooms with counts of billiard tables and bowling alleys by city district, an amusement-venue listing.
review_questions: Could sports-organisations-and-facilities fit better if billiards counts as sport?

tables.title: Door of Hope Statistics for 1917
tables.rationale: 1917 statistics of the Door of Hope refuge for prostitutes: admissions, departures, deaths, inmates, expenses and government funding.
review_questions: Does the vocabulary need a tag for rescue homes for prostitutes?

tables.title: Industries Represented in Teng Shih K'ou District
tables.rationale: Lists store counts by industry and residents by occupation. Occupational composition is the main subject, with shop types as a secondary component.
review_questions: No detailed tag exists for a street-level inventory of shops by industry; a local business-establishments tag could be proposed.

tables.title: List of Shops and Stores on the West Side of Hatamen from Chu Shih Ta Chieh to Teng Shih K'ou
tables.rationale: A numbered textual list of shop names along a street. The content is names and shop types, not statistical quantities.
review_questions: No tag fits a shop directory; propose a business-directory or local-establishments tag.

tables.title: Provinces Represented
tables.rationale: Church families by province of origin, with counts and percentages per congregation. This is origin of residents rather than a recorded migration flow; migration is the closest available tag.
review_questions: Should a tag for place of origin or birthplace be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Time in Peking
tables.rationale: Length of residence in Peking among church families, from one to five years up to a lifetime. This is a residence-duration measure linked to migration.
review_questions: Should a tag for duration of residence be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Infant Mortality
tables.rationale: Births and deaths of children in Ch'i Hua Men families, with survivors and family distributions; titled infant mortality.
review_questions: Table covers child deaths generally, not strictly infants under one year; is infant-mortality an acceptable fit?

tables.title: Income per Year
tables.rationale: Church families classified by yearly income band. No dedicated income-distribution tag exists; household-budgets is the nearest but income only, not expenditure.
review_questions: Propose an income-distribution tag; household-budgets is only an approximate fit.

tables.title: Proportion of Income Spent for Rent
tables.rationale: Share of family income spent on rent among church families; a housing and living-standard measure.
review_questions: Consider a tag for rent burden or household expenditure shares.

tables.title: Families with Servants
tables.rationale: Counts and percentages of church families keeping servants, which is a household living-standard indicator. No existing tag covers domestic servants.
review_questions: Propose a tag for domestic servants or household living standards.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Distances from Shanghai]
tables.rationale: Travel times and distances from Shanghai to nine cities, with corresponding distances from New York. No existing tag fits travel distances.
review_questions: Should a tag for travel distances or routes be added?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Dye Imports from the United States, 1913, 1919-1923]
tables.rationale: Quantities and values of dye imports from the United States, 1913 and 1919-1923. Dyes fit the broad chemicals tag, as the vocabulary names dyestuffs there.
review_questions: Should a dedicated dyes tag be added to the vocabulary?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Dye Imports from All Sources, 1913, 1919-1923]
tables.rationale: Quantities and values of dye imports into China from all sources, 1913 and 1919-1923. Dyes fit the broad chemicals tag.
review_questions: Should a dedicated dyes tag be added to the vocabulary?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Total Value of All Dyes Imported, by Countries of Origin, 1919-1923]
tables.rationale: Total value of dye imports by country of origin, 1919-1923. Dyes fit the broad chemicals tag.
review_questions: Should a dedicated dyes tag be added to the vocabulary?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Imports of Artificial Indigo, by Countries, 1913 and 1919-1923]
tables.rationale: Imports of artificial indigo by country in piculs and taels, 1913 and 1919-1923. Artificial indigo is a synthetic dye and fits the broad chemicals tag; the natural indigo tag does not apply.
review_questions: Should a synthetic dyes tag be added to the vocabulary?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Value of Aniline Dyes Imported into China, by Countries, 1913 and 1919-1923]
tables.rationale: Value of aniline dye imports by country, 1913 and 1919-1923. Aniline dyes fit the broad chemicals tag.
review_questions: Should a dedicated dyes tag be added to the vocabulary?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Total Gross Imports of Foodstuffs, Except Wheat, Wheat Flour, Rice, and Paddy, and Imports from the United States, 1913 and 1923]
tables.rationale: Gross imports of many foodstuffs, total and from the United States, 1913 and 1923. The table is a broad commodity import list, so no commodity tag is chosen.
review_questions: Should a food imports or general foodstuffs tag be added to the vocabulary?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Hardware: Classes Imported, by Countries, 1913, 1918, 1921 and 1923]
tables.rationale: Hardware imports (cutlery, enameled ware, lamps, stoves) by country, with gross imports, reexports and net imports.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a hardware or metal goods tag; consider proposing one.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Imports of Metals and Minerals into China, 1913 and 1923: United States and Total]
tables.rationale: Imports of many metals and metal manufactures in 1913 and 1923, US share and total; a multi-metal summary with no single metal tag fitting.
review_questions: Is a general metals/metal-goods trade tag needed?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Charges and Interest on Gold Bars Shipped from Shanghai to America]
tables.rationale: Costs and interest percentages for shipping gold bars from Shanghai to America: a financial transaction cost breakdown. Not gold mining or trade quantities; closest tag is foreign-exchange, though the table is about bullion shipment costs.
review_questions: Is a tag for bullion shipment costs or gold-bar remittance needed?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Gold Bar Constant Less Charges and Interest]
tables.rationale: Computation of a gold bar's US-dollar value less shipment charges and interest; no existing tag fits precisely.
review_questions: Propose a tag for bullion arbitrage or gold-shipment computation.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Standard Test for Tung Oil (American Society for Testing Materials)]
tables.rationale: Technical specification limits (specific gravity, acid number, etc.) for tung oil under an ASTM standard; quantitative measurement standards for a commodity.
review_questions: Is a tag for commodity quality standards needed? None fits beyond tung-oil.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Exports of Vegetable Tallow from China, 1910–1913 and 1919–1923]
tables.rationale: Vegetable tallow exports from China by year in tons and taels, with destination distribution. No tag exists for vegetable tallow.
review_questions: Propose a vegetable tallow tag (or an animal and vegetable fats tag).

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [China's Trade in Flour: Exports and Imports, 1910–1913 Average and 1917–1923]
tables.rationale: China's flour exports with destination shares and flour imports by year. Flour milling is not a dedicated tag and the table is about trade.
review_questions: Propose a flour tag.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Canton's Exports of Mats and Matting, 1910–1913 Average and 1919–1923]
tables.rationale: Canton's exports of mats and matting by number, rolls and value. No tag exists for mats and matting.
review_questions: Propose a mats and matting tag.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Principal Mines, Grouped According to Products]
tables.rationale: Inventory of principal mines by mineral with paid-up capital, company nationality and head office; no single tag fits a mixed-mineral mine list.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mine or mining-company inventories.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Leading Banks in the Canton Consular District That Handle Foreign Exchange and Bills]
tables.rationale: Inventory of leading foreign-exchange banks by nationality, head office and capital. Content is mostly descriptive text with capital amounts as descriptive entries.
review_questions: Capital entries are textual with amounts; is this a mixed table rather than a text table?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Property Values and Rents in Canton]
tables.rationale: Property purchase prices and monthly rents for office, warehouse and residential space in Canton districts.
review_questions: No tag covers real-estate values and rents specifically; housing is only partial for office and warehouse rents.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Principal Crops of the District]
tables.rationale: Descriptive list of principal crops with producing provinces, planting and harvest seasons and yields per acre. Multi-crop summary in textual form.
review_questions: Yields per acre are quantitative but embedded in text; is this a text table or a mixed table?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Net Quantity and Value of the Principal Imports into Hankow, 1903, 1913, 1923, and 1924]
tables.rationale: Net quantities and values of numerous imported articles into Hankow across four years; broad multi-commodity import table.
review_questions: Printed subtotals and grand totals do not reconcile with components, as noted by the transcriber; figures left unaltered.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [European Hotels in the Hankow District]
tables.rationale: Inventory of European hotels with location, nationality, rooms and daily rates; tourism-related accommodation but not visitor numbers or spending.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a hotels/accommodation tag; 'tourism' was judged not to fit visitor-based content. Propose 'hotels and accommodation'.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Cities of the Mukden Consular District]
tables.rationale: Estimated district populations of Mukden consular district cities with counts of Europeans, Americans and American firms; footnote marks treaty ports.
review_questions: Should treaty-ports be added given footnote marking treaty ports? Table not organised around that system, so omitted.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Value of the Total Foreign Trade of Manchuria, by Ports, 1913, 1922, 1923, and 1924]
tables.rationale: Total foreign trade value by Manchurian port across four years; imports and exports are combined, so neither specific tag fits alone.
review_questions: Is a tag for total or aggregate foreign trade needed?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Important Advertising Mediums in the Shanghai District]
tables.rationale: Advertising mediums, mostly newspapers with nationality and circulation figures; periodicals are minor.
review_questions: Is a tag for advertising media in the press needed? 'advertising' was not selected because the table lists publications rather than advertising expenditure.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Land Transactions: Area in Mow and Cost in Taels, 1918–1923]
tables.rationale: Land transactions by area in mow and cost in taels; no fitting tag for land sales or real-estate transactions.
review_questions: Propose a tag for land and real-estate transactions.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Goods Classification of Important Imports and Exports]
tables.rationale: Railway freight classes for important imports and exports. Content is a classification of goods for railway rates; the class numbers are categorical codes, not quantities.
review_questions: Is there a better tag for railway goods classification, as opposed to rates?

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Principal Hotels at Peking and Tientsin]
tables.rationale: Hotel rates and ownership for Peking and Tientsin, travel facilities; rates are quantitative.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no specific hotel or accommodation tag; tourism is the nearest fit.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Important Manufacturing Industries of Amoy]
tables.rationale: Principal Amoy manufacturing firms with capacity, employees, capital and output; two of three are tinning/canning companies, the third not specified.
review_questions: Third firm (Liok Hong) product is unidentified.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Summary of the Methods of Transportation]
tables.rationale: Compares transport media (railways, steamboats, junks, carts, pack animals) by average load, daily mileage, cost per ton-mile and maximum haul; the cost per ton-mile is the main comparative measure.
review_questions: A tag for general comparison of transport modes is missing from the vocabulary.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Property Values and Rents in Nanking]
tables.rationale: Land purchase prices and rents for office, warehouse and residential space in Nanking sections. This is real-estate pricing, which no existing tag covers.
review_questions: Propose a tag for property values and rents.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Goods Tax on Kiaochow-Tsinan Railway Shipments: Leading Commodities and Rate of Taxation]
tables.rationale: Goods tax rates as percentage of freight charges by commodity on the Kiaochow-Tsinan Railway.
review_questions: Is a tag for railway freight taxation or goods tax needed? Railways tag not clearly central.

book.title: China, a Commercial and Industrial Handbook 1926

tables.title: [Property Values and Rents: Annual Rental of Leased Land in the City of Tsingtao]
tables.rationale: Annual government rental rates for five classes of leased city land. This is land rent and property value, which no existing tag covers; land-tax and land-tenure do not fit.
review_questions: Propose a tag such as 'property-values-and-rents' for urban land rents.

tables.title: [Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corporation — directors, officers and bankers]
tables.rationale: Roster of the bank's directors, officers, auditors and London committee; textual list of office-holders. Bank organisation is the subject, but no tag covers corporate officers precisely; companies is for capital and results.
review_questions: Consider a vocabulary term for company directors and officers.

tables.title: [Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corporation — branches and agencies]
tables.rationale: List of bank branch and agency locations; textual and not statistical. No detailed tag fits a branch network list.
review_questions: Consider a vocabulary term for bank branch networks.

tables.title: [Canadian Pacific Railway Company — offices for rates, passages, etc.]
tables.rationale: Addresses of Canadian Pacific Railway offices in European cities; advertisement contact list with no statistical content, and the railway is not described operationally.
review_questions: Consider a term for transport company offices or advertisements.

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)
tables.rationale: Triangular table of nautical distances between ports on the route from London to Japan. No vocabulary tag fits geographical distance tables.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables, e.g. 'distances'.

tables.title: Distances (via Siberia)
tables.rationale: Triangular table of distances via Siberia between European and Chinese places; no suitable detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—A
tables.rationale: Triangular table of coast distances between Chinese ports; no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B
tables.rationale: Triangular table of coast distances between north China ports; no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables.

tables.title: Distances up the Yangtze
tables.rationale: Triangular table of distances between places along the Yangtze; it gives distances only, with no navigation measures or river description. No fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables.

tables.title: [Distances from Shanghai]
tables.rationale: Distances in miles from Shanghai to six ports; no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables.

tables.title: Sacred Mountains
tables.rationale: List of the five sacred mountains with provinces; textual list of mountains. Religious significance is implied by the title but no religious institutions or adherents are tabulated.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for sacred sites or pilgrimage be added?

tables.title: [Other famous mountains]
tables.rationale: Descriptions of famous mountains with locations and some heights, plus pilgrimage notes; mainly textual mountain descriptions.
review_questions: Pilgrimage and monastery content is incidental; consider a sacred-sites term.

tables.title: [Chief lakes of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Descriptions of the chief lakes of China Proper, with dimensions, areas, altitudes and links to the Yangtze and Grand Canal. The table mixes text with quantities.
review_questions: Should a dedicated lakes tag be proposed? rivers-and-waterways covers connected lakes but not lakes in general.

tables.title: [Chemical analysis of beancake]
tables.rationale: Percentage chemical composition of beancake, a soybean product.
review_questions: Is a tag for feed or chemical composition needed? None exists in the vocabulary.

tables.title: [Movement of fibres through the Customs since 1906]
tables.rationale: Tons of fibres (abutilon, hemp, jute, ramie) moving through the Customs. Whether the movement is imports or exports is not stated.
review_questions: Does the 'movement' through the Customs mean imports, exports or both?

tables.title: [Exports of strawbraid in recent years]
tables.rationale: Annual quantity (cwt.) and value of strawbraid exports, 1906-1910. No specific strawbraid tag exists; plant-fibre or textile status is not established.
review_questions: Propose a tag for straw braid/hat-braid, a handicraft export commodity.

tables.title: [Shares of France, Great Britain and the United States in the strawbraid export]
tables.rationale: Percentage shares of France, Great Britain and the United States in strawbraid exports by year. These are export destinations.
review_questions: Propose a tag for straw braid.

tables.title: [Export of vermicelli in recent years]
tables.rationale: Annual export quantities of vermicelli in pounds, 1906-1910.
review_questions: Propose a tag for noodles/vermicelli, since food-processing is not clearly established by this export series.

tables.title: [Movement of flour through Customs stations]
tables.rationale: Movement of flour through Customs stations in bushels by year, with one value remark. This is internal commodity movement; the wheat heading is incidental to flour.
review_questions: Propose a flour/flour-milling tag.

tables.title: [The Nungkungshangpu's summary of mines in operation, etc.]
tables.rationale: Counts of mines by province and status (operating but unregistered, known but not operated, worked out). No existing tag covers mine inventories by status.
review_questions: Consider a tag for mine counts/inventories by operational status.

tables.title: [Theoretical tables of Chinese money]
tables.rationale: Theoretical equivalences of Chinese money units in the tael and dollar systems, a table of monetary denominations.
review_questions: Should measurement-and-units apply to unit conversion tables of money?

tables.title: [Order in which the Western nations had direct trade dealings with China]
tables.rationale: Chronological list of years when Western nations first had direct trade dealings with China; the years are dates, not statistical quantities.
review_questions: Is a tag for early foreign-trade history needed? Historical-chronologies is used as the closest fit.

tables.title: Treaty Ports, Marts, etc.
tables.rationale: Lists treaty ports, places opened to trade and ports of call, with opening dates and the treaties that opened them. It also gives Chinese population estimates for the customs stations, so the content is mixed statistical/text.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no tag for ports of call or river stages as such.

tables.title: [Trade between China and Great Britain, 1904–1910, from British Trade Returns]
tables.rationale: China-Great Britain trade from British returns: merchandise consigned both ways plus bullion and specie flows, 1904-1910.
review_questions: Bullion and specie flows are included; no dedicated tag exists for bullion trade.

tables.title: Per Capita Consumption of Tea
tables.rationale: Per capita tea consumption by country and period. It is a consumption measure rather than imports or exports, so no more specific tag applies.
review_questions: Should a tag for commodity consumption be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Bullion and Specie: Import and Export in Pounds Sterling, 1908-1910
tables.rationale: Imports and exports of gold, silver and copper bullion and coin in £, 1908-1910, with net export. This is trade in bullion and specie rather than mining or reserves.
review_questions: Should a silver or bullion-and-specie tag be added to the vocabulary? Silver is a major component, but only three tags are allowed.

tables.title: [South Manchuria Railway Company: capital expenditure up to September 30, 1910]
tables.rationale: Capital expenditure of the South Manchuria Railway Company by category (railway, electricity, gas, harbour, mines, hotels, land, buildings). The tabulated measure is company capital outlay, and no existing tag fits it.
review_questions: Propose a tag for company capital expenditure or investment accounts (e.g. 'capital-expenditure'). Is 'companies' appropriate?

tables.title: [Main national highways and other important roads]
tables.rationale: Numbered list of road routes between places, with only incidental distances in brackets. It is essentially a textual route list. The vocabulary has no tag for road routes, since roads-and-bridges covers infrastructure measures such as mileage and works.
review_questions: Should a tag for road routes or highways be added?

tables.title: [Chief railway bridges]
tables.rationale: Chief railway bridges with river, railway, length, spans and cost. These are quantitative bridge measurements for railway lines. roads-and-bridges excludes bridges tabulated only as railway assets, so only railways is supported.
review_questions: Should a tag for bridges or railway bridges be added?

tables.title: Foreign Post Offices in China
tables.rationale: Lists of foreign-operated post offices in China by country, including offices in leased territories and Manchuria. This is a text list of offices showing foreign privileges. Postal services is the specific fitting tag; foreign-concessions does not clearly apply to every listed office.
review_questions: Is a tag for foreign postal privileges needed?

tables.title: [Sub-departments of the Department of Ceremonies (Tienliyuan)]
tables.rationale: Describes the sub-departments of the Department of Ceremonies and their court ceremonial duties; textual administrative description.
review_questions: Court ceremonial might fit imperial-household if that tag is judged applicable.

tables.title: [Departments of the Imperial Board of Astronomy (Ch'intach'en)]
tables.rationale: Describes the departments of the Imperial Board of Astronomy and their functions; textual. Headnote says four but five are listed, as printed.

tables.rationale: Postal staff by grade 1908 and 1922; employment in the postal service. No tag specifically fits postal personnel; employment-and-unemployment is not about work status or the workforce as a whole.
review_questions: Consider a tag for public-service staffing, e.g. postal personnel.

tables.title: [Nationalities of Foreign Employees]
tables.rationale: Foreign employees of the Chinese Post Office by nationality. This is a staffing breakdown, not a population subject, so nationality-and-ethnicity is not applied.
review_questions: Is a tag for postal staff or foreign employees needed?

tables.title: [Money Order Issues, 1920-22]
tables.rationale: Annual money order amounts 1920-22; the column headings are generic.
review_questions: The two columns are unlabelled (presumably issued and cashed); confirm.

tables.title: [Closure of Former Foreign Postal Agencies in China]
tables.rationale: Counts of former foreign postal agencies in China by nationality, with dates of closure. This concerns foreign privileges in China and postal services. Numbers are substantive agency counts, so it is statistical.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for foreign post offices or foreign privileges in communications be added?

tables.title: Small Coin Accounts
tables.rationale: Small coin account investments: fixed deposits, building and land, mortgages. Only three items, mostly deposits and property, so securities-and-investment is a weak fit.
review_questions: Is a tag for postal savings bank investments or assets needed?

tables.title: Wireless Stations in Operation or Under Construction in China
tables.rationale: Inventory of wireless stations with ranges, power, and wavelengths (quantitative). Many are foreign-owned or foreign army/navy controlled on Chinese soil, with remarks on Japanese troop stations and legation stations.
review_questions: Is a dedicated wireless/radio-telegraph tag needed? Radio is broadcasting-oriented, so telegraph was used.

tables.title: [Radio Stations in China and Hongkong Summary by Control]
tables.rationale: Counts of the 33 radio stations in China and Hongkong by controlling nationality; foreign control of stations is substantial.
review_questions: Is a wireless-specific tag needed?

tables.title: Sugar
tables.rationale: Import tariff for sugar, wines, spirits, beer and mineral waters, with units and duty rates. The title understates the content.
review_questions: Title says Sugar but the body is mostly alcoholic drinks; confirm title/content. No fitting 'alcohol' tag that avoids implying manufacture — tariff tag retained.

tables.title: Candles, Gums, Oils, Soap, Varnishes, Wax, Etc.
tables.rationale: Tariff rates on candles, gums, mineral oils, waxes and similar goods. This is a mixed list with no single fitting commodity tag.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for mixed oils, waxes and gums tariff goods?

tables.title: [Customs Import Tariff: Oils, Wax, and Soap]
tables.rationale: Import duty rates on oils, soap, turpentine and waxes; a mixed schedule without one dominant commodity.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for mixed oils, waxes and soap goods?

tables.title: Bones, Feathers, Hair, Horns, Shells, Sinews, Tusks, Etc.
tables.rationale: Import duty rates on bones, feathers, hair, horns and tusks; miscellaneous animal products with no fitting specific tag.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for miscellaneous animal products?

tables.title: Asbestos
tables.rationale: Import duty rates on asbestos products (packing, millboard, sheets, yarn). No dedicated asbestos tag exists in the vocabulary.
review_questions: Should an asbestos tag be proposed?

tables.title: Revenue of Each Port, 1922
tables.rationale: Tonnage dues collected at each treaty port in 1922, split by Chinese and foreign flag. This is a port-level fiscal measure tied to shipping and ports. No tag covers customs dues on shipping, and customs-revenue is for duties rather than tonnage dues, so only ports is used.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for tonnage dues or port dues?

tables.title: Imports.—Continued
tables.rationale: Continued commodity import statistics covering metals, textiles and manufactures. The later rows appear to restart the item numbering with an export-style series (items 1-67), so the table mixes imports and exports.
review_questions: Does the later restarted numbering belong to the export series rather than imports?

tables.title: Carrying Trade from and to Foreign Countries, 1922
tables.rationale: Carrying trade by flag in 1922: vessel entries, tonnage, foreign imports carried, import duties and tonnage dues. Combines shipping tonnage by nationality with trade values and duties.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for carrying trade by flag or tonnage dues?

tables.title: Carrying Trade Between the Open Ports of China, 1922
tables.rationale: Coast carrying trade between open ports by flag: clearances, tonnage, Chinese export and re-export values, export duties and tonnage dues.
review_questions: Is there a tag for coastal trade between ports? Domestic-trade is the closest fit.

tables.title: Movement of Vegetable Tallow through the Customs
tables.rationale: Customs movement of vegetable tallow, quantity and value, for 1921 and 1922. No vocabulary tag covers tallow or wax, and the table does not clearly separate imports from exports.
review_questions: Propose a tag for vegetable tallow and wax products.

tables.title: [Estimated Quantity of Walnuts Produced by Province]
tables.rationale: Estimated walnut quantities by province. Walnuts fit no specific tag; horticulture is an approximate fit but not clearly supported.
review_questions: Propose a tag for nuts or tree crops such as walnuts.

tables.title: [Chinese and Turki Monetary Denominations]
tables.rationale: Chinese and Turki monetary denominations and equivalences used in Sinkiang, a description of the monetary system.
review_questions: Could measurement-and-units also apply to these denomination equivalences, or is currency sufficient?

tables.title: [Western Nations in the Order of Direct Trade Dealings with China]
tables.rationale: List of Western nations with the year each first traded directly with China. It is a short chronological list, and the years are only dates. No existing tag fits it well.
review_questions: Should a tag for early foreign trade contacts be added?

tables.title: Customs Districts
tables.rationale: Numbered customs districts with their coastal and river limits; textual list of jurisdictions.
review_questions: Should a customs-jurisdiction tag be proposed? Administrative-divisions is the nearest fit.

tables.title: Yangtze and West River Stages
tables.rationale: Ports of call on Yangtze and West River with permitted traffic and the agreements that opened them; textual list on river navigation under treaty agreements.
review_questions: Is a tag for treaty river stages needed? None exists in the vocabulary.

tables.title: [Number of 10-Cash Pieces to the Dollar at Treaty Ports, 1918-1922]
tables.rationale: Number of 10-cash copper pieces per dollar at treaty ports, showing the depreciation of copper coinage. The measure is a copper-cash/dollar exchange rate.
review_questions: Does copper cash against dollar quotation warrant foreign-exchange, or is it domestic currency valuation only?

tables.title: [Approximate Exchange Value Between Taels]
tables.rationale: Equivalences between Kuping, Haikwan, Shanghai and local taels at treaty ports are monetary-unit conversions within China's currency system.
review_questions: Tael equivalence between local taels is not exchange between currencies; a tag for monetary units or tael equivalence could be proposed.

tables.title: 1. Treasure Imported From and Exported to Foreign Countries during 1922
tables.rationale: Treasure (gold, silver, copper coin) imported into China in 1922 by country of origin, valued in Haikwan taels.
review_questions: Gold and silver bullion imports are mixed with coin; no specific tag for treasure/bullion flows exists.

tables.title: Treasure Imported and Exported, 1922—Continued
tables.rationale: Treasure (gold, silver, copper coin) exported from China in 1922 by destination, in Haikwan taels.
review_questions: No specific tag for treasure/bullion flows.

tables.title: Coins Imported from and Exported to Foreign Countries during 1922 (included in 1)
tables.rationale: Numbers of gold, silver and copper coins by type moved across borders in 1922, by country; coin circulation is the main subject.
review_questions: A tag for coin movements or treasure flows could be proposed.

tables.title: [Monthly Expenses of Central Government, Sections 8–10, N, O]
tables.rationale: Remaining central government monthly expense items (Mongolian and Tibetan bureau, imperial pensions) and the grand total of fifteen sections. It is budget expenditure.
review_questions: Is a tag for imperial pensions needed? Existing tags only partly fit, and imperial-household is not clearly about pension finance.

tables.title: The Latest Concise Table of the Collections of the Peking Octroi.
tables.rationale: Collections of the Peking octroi and their earmarked monthly funds (notes redemption, schools, judiciary reform, students in Japan). The octroi is a local levy and the table shows how its revenue is allocated.
review_questions: Is a tag for octroi or local levies needed?

tables.title: Chinese Government Central Salt Administration. Revenue Account with the Group Banks for the Three Years, 1921, 1922 and 1923
tables.rationale: Salt Administration revenue account listing loan and indemnity charges secured on salt revenue for 1921-1923. The debt-service component is the main focus.
review_questions: Would a tag for salt revenue securing loans (salt-revenue-securities) be useful? The existing salt-tax tag may not fit because the table shows loan charges rather than tax receipts.

tables.title: Salt Revenue Account with the Group Banks.—(Continued)
tables.rationale: Salt Revenue Account with the Group Banks: releases to the central government, retained and appropriated revenue, and sums refunded by the Maritime Customs. The subject is salt revenue allocation.
review_questions: Is a tag for revenue sharing between central and provincial authorities needed?

tables.title: Foreign Claims
tables.rationale: Foreign claims by country and category arising from the Lincheng outrage, presented in dollars. This is an interstate claims matter; no vocabulary tag fits claims for compensation, which are distinct from treaty indemnities.
review_questions: Propose a tag for diplomatic claims or compensation for incidents.

tables.title: [Band Strength Table]
tables.rationale: Personnel of an army band, giving two figures whose column labels are missing. The figures are statistical, though unlabelled.
review_questions: The column meanings are not labelled on this page; check the preceding page.

review_questions: Is a tag for warlord factions or political affiliation of armed forces needed?

tables.rationale: Monthly pay and allowances by rank in the Luchun (army); pay of military personnel. Government-offices and wages tags concern civil or general pay, so only army is applied.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: Glossary of military terms with Chinese characters and romanisation; textual, not statistical. No fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for glossaries or terminology?

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers.
tables.rationale: Active strength of the Shanghai Volunteers by unit, officers and other ranks. It is a militia of the foreign settlement; no existing tag fits a volunteer corps.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer corps or militia. Should this table also carry foreign-concessions?

tables.title: Table Showing Number of Chinese Naval Students
tables.rationale: Chinese naval students by naval college, graduates, undergraduates and those abroad; the institutions are naval, so navy is the subject tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for military education. Should students-abroad apply to the small abroad rows?

tables.title: Foreign Advisers to the Government of China
tables.rationale: Foreign advisers to Chinese government offices with nationality and position; textual roster. Foreign direction of the sovereign state is supported only weakly, but advisers are in government offices.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for foreign advisers be added?

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)
tables.rationale: Matrix of nautical-mile distances between ports on the European and Far Eastern sea routes. The subject is route distances between ports, which no existing tag covers precisely.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances; shipping and ports tags measure traffic or fleets, not distances.

tables.title: Distances (Via Siberia)
tables.rationale: Distances from London and Europe to Chinese cities by the Siberian rail-sea route. This is a route-distance table, not traffic or railway operating data.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances. The Moscow/Mukden value is unreadable ([?]).

tables.title: Coast Distances.—A
tables.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and southern China ports. Only route distances are given, with no traffic or port measures.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B
tables.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and northern China ports. Only route distances are given.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances.

tables.title: Distances up the Yangtze
tables.rationale: River distances in miles between Yangtze ports from Shanghai to Chungking, for navigation reference. The table gives distances, not river physical description, navigation traffic or cargo.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances. One Shasi/Shanghai value is unreadable.

tables.title: [Shanghai to Dairen, Newchwang, Vladivostok and Japanese Ports Distances]
tables.rationale: Sea distances from Shanghai to northern and Japanese ports. Only route distances are given.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances.

tables.title: Iron Ore Production, 1919-1923
tables.rationale: Iron ore output by mine 1919-1923, with capital source and ore type.
review_questions: The '1929' column header may be a misprint for 1922.

tables.title: Distance of Coal Fields and Iron Ore Deposits from Iron Works
tables.rationale: Compares each ironworks with the coal fields and iron ore deposits that supply it, giving rail or river distances. The subject is raw-material sourcing for iron works.
review_questions: A tag for raw-material supply distances or industrial location may be needed.

tables.title: [Composition of Best Quality Refined Yunnan Tin]
tables.rationale: Percentage chemical composition of the best refined Yunnan tin. It is a quantitative measurement of a tin product.
review_questions: A tag for metal quality or composition standards may be needed.

tables.title: [Shuik'oushan Mine Concentrated Ore Production Since 1912]
tables.rationale: Concentrated zinc ore, lead ore and sulphur output of one mine; zinc and lead dominate.
review_questions: Sulphur has no dedicated tag.

tables.title: [Mercury Export Statistics, 1918–1923]
tables.rationale: Mercury export tonnages used to illustrate production variation.
review_questions: No mercury tag exists in the vocabulary; propose one.

tables.title: [Molybdenum Ore Exports, 1920-1923]
tables.rationale: Molybdenum ore exports, with some figures unreadable but quantities intended.
review_questions: No molybdenum tag exists in the vocabulary; propose one.

tables.title: [Bismuth Ore Exports, 1920-1922]
tables.rationale: Customs figures for bismuth ore exports in tons, 1920-1922; exports are the principal measure.
review_questions: Bismuth has no dedicated mineral tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Arsenic Export from Hankow, 1921-1923]
tables.rationale: Arsenic exports from Hankow by year in tons, taken from customs returns.
review_questions: Arsenic has no dedicated tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Orpiment and Realgar Exports via Tengyueh, 1919-1923]
tables.rationale: Yearly exports of orpiment and realgar via Tengyueh, in tons.
review_questions: Orpiment and realgar (arsenic minerals) have no dedicated tag.

tables.title: [Talc and Magnesite Production, 1920–1922]
tables.rationale: Production of talc and magnesite in tons for 1920-1922, two non-metal minerals.
review_questions: Talc and magnesite have no specific tags.

tables.title: Manufactured Asbestos
tables.rationale: Manufactured asbestos output in catties by the Tientsin Co., 1918-1923. No existing tag covers asbestos or building-material manufacture of this kind.
review_questions: Propose an asbestos or non-metallic minerals tag.

tables.title: [Percentages of Cephalic Types among the Living Population of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Percentages of cephalic (head-shape) types in the living population of China proper, a physical-anthropology measurement. No existing tag covers physical anthropology or racial type.
review_questions: Propose a tag for physical anthropology or racial characteristics; nationality-and-ethnicity was not used as the table classifies physical type, not nationality or ethnic community.

tables.title: [Classification of Mon-Khmer Aboriginal Groups]
tables.rationale: Textual classification of Mon-Khmer aboriginal groups and tribes (V. K. Ting's scheme), with no quantities. Shown as ethnological classification; it is not evidently about indigenous institutions or policy.
review_questions: Does ethnological classification of aboriginal peoples warrant indigenous-peoples, or a new tag for ethnological classification?

tables.title: [Classification of Aboriginal Races: Shan and Tibeto-Burman Groups]
tables.rationale: Textual classification of Shan and Tibeto-Burman aboriginal peoples into groups and subgroups, with no quantities. Ethnological classification only.
review_questions: Does ethnological classification of aboriginal peoples warrant indigenous-peoples, or a new tag for ethnological classification?

tables.title: [Rulers of the Manchu Dynasty]
tables.rationale: List of Manchu dynasty rulers with reign years, supporting a historical summary. The reign dates are incidental to a textual roster. The ruler succession does not match the narrower imperial-household definition (court, royal family and household institutions).
review_questions: Consider a tag for dynastic succession or ruler lists.

tables.title: [Number of Students and Teachers of Middle School Grade or Lower]
tables.rationale: Mission school presiding officers with teacher counts, enrolment, average age and library volumes. Mission affiliation is only implied by officers and abbreviations, so no mission-schools tag.
review_questions: Does the table's mission-school context warrant a mission-schools tag?

tables.title: Christian Elementary and Secondary Schools.
tables.rationale: Christian lower primary, higher primary and middle schools and students by province. Mission-school affiliation is plausible, but the table does not show mission operation explicitly.
review_questions: Should Christian schools here carry mission-schools, or christianity?

tables.title: [Unlabelled Column of Revenue Figures]
tables.rationale: A degraded column of revenue figures from the customs revenue section with famine relief surtax notes; labels are unreadable, but the intended quantities are statistical and the section is customs revenue. Tags are withheld because the labels cannot be read and the content cannot be confirmed.
review_questions: Can the labels be recovered to confirm customs-revenue and famine-relief-surtax content?

tables.title: [Direct Foreign Trade of Each Port]
tables.rationale: Direct foreign trade by port with imports, exports and totals, plus re-export totals and a net total.
review_questions: Table title and the two column sets are unlabelled, so the years are not identified.

tables.title: Imports (Gross) for 1921, 1922 and 1923
tables.rationale: Gross imports by commodity for 1921-1923, covering living animals, foods and beverages and raw materials, with quantities and values. No single commodity dominates.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for commodity-classified trade statistics.

tables.title: [Imports of Plants, Fodder, Timber, Dye-woods and Common Metals, 1921–1923]
tables.rationale: Imports by quantity and value for plants, fodder, timber, dye-woods and common metals, 1921-1923. The items are diverse.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for commodity-classified trade statistics.

tables.rationale: Exports of food articles (cereals, flour, vegetables, tea, sugar, oils, salt, beverages), with quantity and value for 1921-1923.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for commodity-classified trade statistics.

tables.title: Exports.—Continued
tables.rationale: Continuation of exports of raw and prepared materials (skins, bones, hair, oil-cake, seeds, tobacco, timber), 1921-1923.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for commodity-classified trade statistics.

tables.title: [Exports of Metals, Minerals, Textiles and Other Articles, 1921–1923]
tables.rationale: Exports of metals, minerals, textiles and other articles by quantity and value, 1921-1923. Many commodities appear, so no single commodity tag is used.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for commodity-classified trade statistics.

tables.title: Exports.—Continued
tables.rationale: Continuation of exports covering textile fibres and manufactured products, with quantities and values for 1921-1923.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for commodity-classified trade statistics.

review_questions: British export duties value is unreadable in the transcription.

tables.title: Coast Trade Inwards
tables.rationale: Coast trade inwards by flag: tonnage of entries, Chinese and foreign import values and duties. The row labels are unreadable in the transcription.

tables.title: [Railway Contracts and Lines Referred to in Manchuria and Mongolia, 1918]
tables.rationale: Numbered list of four Manchurian and Mongolian railway lines covered by the 1918 loan. It is textual, with no quantities. Railway lines are the subject.

tables.rationale: Railway lines under contract, with the state of each scheme and approximate mileage. The mileages are quantitative, so the table is mixed text and statistics. The subject is railway development.

tables.rationale: Distribution of railway investment assets by construction and financial accounts for each line, ending in the total cost carried to the balance sheet. The substance is capital cost accounts of railways.

tables.title: Asbestos

review_questions: No asbestos tag exists in the vocabulary.

tables.title: Bags, Mats and Matting
tables.rationale: Import duty rates for bags, mats and matting of various materials.
review_questions: No tag fits mats and bags as a category.

tables.title: [Number of Flour Mills by Province]

review_questions: Consider proposing a dedicated flour-milling tag.

tables.title: [Estimated Walnut Production by Province]
tables.rationale: Trade-based estimates of walnut output by province; this is a single horticultural product with no matching tag (horticulture covers fruit and garden crops but walnuts are tree nuts, borderline).

tables.title: Export of Medicines and Allied Products, 1922 and 1923
tables.rationale: Exports of medicines and allied products (musk, nutgalls, liquorice, ginger, camphor, cassia, aniseed) by quantity and value for 1922 and 1923.

tables.title: Export 1923
tables.rationale: Exports of fresh, dried and salted fish and cuttlefish in 1923, quantity and value; the fishing trade is the subject.
review_questions: Should a fish-products trade tag be added? Fishing was not assigned because the table records exports rather than catches.

tables.title: Export 1922
tables.rationale: Exports of fresh, dried and salted fish and cuttlefish in 1922, quantity and value.
review_questions: Should a fish-products trade tag be added?

tables.title: Morphia and Morphia Pills Seized and Destroyed in Peking, 1924
tables.rationale: Morphia and morphia pills seized and destroyed in Peking in 1924, with quantities in ounces, parcels and bags.
review_questions: One pill count per bag is unreadable in the transcription.

tables.title: [Number of Narcotic Drug Manufacturers by Country]
tables.rationale: Counts of narcotic drug manufacturers by country, inferred from labels on seized drugs. No existing tag covers drug manufacture sources.
review_questions: Should a tag for narcotic manufacture or drug origin be added?

tables.title: Monthly Expenses of Various Governors-General
tables.rationale: Monthly expenses of offices of Governors-General; these are military-administrative offices of the central budget, with no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Is a tag for military-administrative offices needed? government-offices may fit if treated as civil offices.

tables.title: N.—Monthly Expenses of the Bureau for Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs
tables.rationale: Monthly expenses of the Bureau for Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs, including allowances to princes and lamas. It is central government expenditure.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for frontier or minority administration?

tables.title: The Latest Concise Table of the Collections of the Peking Octroi
tables.rationale: Peking Octroi collections and monthly funds earmarked for notes, schools, judiciary and students; a local levy with no matching tag.
review_questions: Should a tag for local or octroi levies be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: General Statement of Liabilities, Ministry of Communications
tables.rationale: Ministry of Communications liabilities (loans, railway, telegraph, postal obligations) with principal and interest outstanding; debt of a government ministry, with railway and communications content.
review_questions: Is a tag for government-ministry or railway debt needed?

tables.title: [Payments and Security of Loans]
tables.rationale: Interest payment dates and pledged security for numbered loan issues; content is mostly textual (dates and security descriptions) with no substantive quantities.
review_questions: Loan identities are not given, only numbers; confirm they refer to government bond series.

tables.title: Account with the Group Banks for the Three Years, 1922, 1923 and 1924
tables.rationale: Yearly charges on salt revenue paid via Group Banks for loan obligations, by loan: fiscal salt revenue.
review_questions: Is a tag for loans secured on salt revenue needed?

tables.title: [Tsungwenmen Octroi Collections, 1923 and 1924]
tables.rationale: Monthly octroi collections at Tsungwenmen for 1923 and 1924 are a tax revenue series.
review_questions: Is a dedicated tag for octroi or internal transit levies needed? Likin is specifically defined and is not clearly the same levy.

tables.title: Coast Districts (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continuation of coast districts with their textual limits, serving the coast lighting arrangement.
review_questions: Is this list better understood as Customs administrative districts than navigation aids? No fitting vocabulary tag for Customs district jurisdiction.

tables.title: Commemoration Days of the Republic
tables.rationale: A list of commemoration dates and the republican events they mark; the content is textual. It is not a general chronology, so historical-chronologies is not assigned.
review_questions: Is a tag for public holidays or commemorations needed?

tables.title: [Budget, Commerce and Shipping of Kwangchouwan, 1923]
tables.rationale: Mixed summary of Kwangchouwan's 1923 budget, imports and exports, and steamer shipping. No single detailed tag covers it without selecting incidental components.
review_questions: Is a general territory economic-summary tag needed for budget, commerce and shipping overviews?

tables.title: [Half-yearly Index Figures, December 1913 to December 1924]
tables.rationale: Half-yearly index values from 1913 to 1924 in a currency and copper coin section. The index is not named in the table, so the subject is uncertain; the finance topic is supported by the chapter context only.
review_questions: What do the index figures measure (copper coin exchange rate?). The table title and columns do not say.

tables.title: Cost of Dollar-Coining at Nanking.
tables.rationale: Itemised daily cost of coining dollars at the Nanking mint, covering bullion, coal, wages, interest and other costs. It is an operating cost account. No existing tag fits mint operations.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mints and coinage operations.

tables.title: Foreign Banks Operating in China — Capital
tables.rationale: Capital columns of the foreign banks list, giving authorized and paid-up capital with branch locations.
review_questions: Row-to-bank alignment is uncertain for two banks.

tables.title: Financial State of the Mint When Wound Up
tables.rationale: Receipts and disbursements of the Shanghai mint when it was wound up, covering bond proceeds, land, buildings, machinery and the cash balance. It is a financial account. No existing tag fits mint accounts.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mints and coinage operations.

tables.title: Summary of Exchange—Highest and Lowest with Average Monthly Rates, 1924-25
tables.rationale: Monthly highest and lowest T.T. exchange rates on dollars and sterling, with bar silver prices and average monthly rates, for 1924-25.
review_questions: Bar silver price quotations are not separately covered; consider a precious-metal price tag.

tables.title: Import and Export of Gold, Silver, and Merchandise, 1914 to 1923
tables.rationale: Annual imports and exports of gold, silver and merchandise with net balances, 1914-1923. The rows are trade flows of treasure and merchandise.
review_questions: Silver trade has no dedicated treasure-trade tag beyond the silver commodity tag; gold was chosen as the most useful commodity tag.

tables.title: Tartar Generals (Tutung)
tables.rationale: List of three Tartar Generals (Tutung) for Chahar, Jehol and Suiyuan; textual office-holder list for territorial administration. Tutung posts are subnational authorities, so local-government is the closest fit.
review_questions: Does the Tutung post fall under local-government or a separate special-territory administration category?

tables.title: Foreign Advisers to the Government of China
tables.rationale: List of foreign advisers employed by Chinese government offices and ministries, with nationality and position; a textual roster of official personnel. No count or quantity is tabulated.
review_questions: Should foreign advisers to a nominally sovereign government warrant informal-imperialism? Evidence of control or privilege is not shown, so it is not assigned.

tables.title: [Distribution of Shipping Visiting Shanghai by Flag, 1913, 1918 and 1921]
tables.rationale: Percentage shares of shipping visiting Shanghai by flag for 1913, 1918 and 1921; statistical shipping traffic by nationality of vessel.
review_questions: Shanghai is a treaty port, but the table does not organise its subject around that system, so treaty-ports is not assigned.

tables.title: Newspapers and Periodicals in Peking District (Continued)
tables.rationale: Directory of newspapers and periodicals in the Peking District (title, place, proprietor, frequency, language). Mixed newspapers and periodicals, so neither the newspapers nor the periodicals tag fits alone. The content is textual with no quantities.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Newspapers and Periodicals — Peking District (Continued)
tables.rationale: Textual directory of Peking District newspapers and periodicals with proprietors, frequency and language. It mixes newspapers and periodicals, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Fukien District
tables.rationale: Textual list of Fukien District newspapers and periodicals by place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kiangsu District — Continued
tables.rationale: Textual list of Kiangsu District newspapers and periodicals with proprietors and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kiangsu District.—Continued
tables.rationale: Textual list of Kiangsu and Shanghai District newspapers and periodicals, with place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Shanghai District—Continued
tables.rationale: Long textual directory of Shanghai District Chinese-language periodicals and newspapers, giving place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Foreign Periodicals
tables.rationale: Textual list of foreign-language newspapers and periodicals in Shanghai with editors, frequency and language. It mixes dailies and weeklies, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Shanghai District—Continued
tables.rationale: Textual list of Shanghai District foreign-language periodicals and newspapers with proprietors, frequency and language. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kwangsi District
tables.rationale: Textual list of Kwangsi District newspapers and periodicals with place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kwangtung District
tables.rationale: Large textual directory of Kwangtung District newspapers and periodicals, including a foreign section. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: The Tibetan Frontier Garrison
tables.rationale: Roster of Tibetan frontier garrison and Kweichow units with commanders, stations and notes; no strength column, only totals in notes.
review_questions: Totals row (30,000) and footnote (4,000) conflict; is the table statistical enough to drop the text-tables flag?

tables.title: [Gendarmerie in Kiangsu]
tables.rationale: Gendarmerie in Kiangsu including salt and water police units, with commanders, stations and a total of 50,000 men. Mixed military and police character; no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Consider a vocabulary term for gendarmerie or paramilitary police forces; the police tag may fit but the force is military-organised.

tables.title: Military Pay
tables.rationale: Monthly pay and allowances by army rank in the Luchun, with a footnote on food deductions. The figures are quantitative. The rank structure is secondary to the pay scale.
review_questions: Is a military pay or salary tag needed? The vocabulary lacks one: wages is labour-oriented, and honours-and-ranks excludes salary tables without a substantive rank structure.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: A glossary of Chinese military terms giving English, Chinese and romanised forms. It is purely textual with no quantities. No existing tag fits a terminology glossary.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for military terminology or glossaries?

tables.title: [Types of Military and Semi-Military Organizations]
tables.rationale: Glossary of Chinese terms for military and semi-military organisations with English equivalents; textual, no quantities. No vocabulary tag covers military terminology or organisation types.
review_questions: Consider a tag for military organisation terminology or irregular forces.

tables.title: [Distribution of Japanese Troops in Manchuria]
tables.rationale: Textual list of Japanese army units by location in South Manchuria (6th Division); no quantities beyond regiment counts as unit descriptions.
review_questions: Does Japanese railway-zone garrisoning in Manchuria warrant foreign-garrisons or colonial topics given the leased territory context?

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers
tables.rationale: Strength of Shanghai Volunteer Corps active units by officers and other ranks; a volunteer land force.
review_questions: Is a tag for volunteer or municipal defence forces needed?

tables.title: Table Showing Number of Chinese Naval Students
tables.rationale: Chinese naval students by college, graduates, undergraduates and those abroad; naval training counts.
review_questions: Consider a tag for military education; students-abroad has only trivial counts here.

tables.title: Chinese Naval Yards
tables.rationale: Describes Chinese naval yards and dry docks with repair facilities and dock dimensions.
review_questions: Dry docks and shipyards are not covered by a specific tag, so only navy is assigned; consider a shipyards or naval-bases term.

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)
tables.rationale: Matrix of nautical-mile distances between London and Far Eastern ports; no existing tag covers distance tables.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distances or sea routes.

tables.title: Distances (Via Siberia)
tables.rationale: Distance matrix between London, Siberian and Chinese cities along the Siberian route. It is geographic distance data with a travel-route context. No vocabulary tag covers distances between places.
review_questions: Propose a tag such as 'distances' for inter-place distance tables.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—A.
tables.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and southern ports. This is geographic distance data, and no existing tag covers it.
review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B.
tables.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and northern ports. This is geographic distance data, and no existing tag covers it.
review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.

tables.title: Distances Up the Yangtze
tables.rationale: Matrix of river distances between Yangtze ports from Shanghai to Chungking. It is distance data rather than navigation traffic or river regime description, so no tag fits well.
review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.
