tables.title: [Distances from Shanghai to Northern and Japanese Ports]
tables.rationale: List of sea distances from Shanghai to northern and Japanese ports. It is geographic distance data, and no existing tag covers it.
review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.

tables.title: Table Showing the Highest and Lowest Water at Hankow from 1865 to 1924. With Reference to Lowest Record in 1868
tables.rationale: Annual highest and lowest river stages at Hankow, 1865-1924. These are river water-regime observations rather than flood events.
review_questions: Does the highest-water data justify a floods tag? No flood damage or inundation is shown.

tables.title: Annual Variation.
tables.rationale: The table gives monthly prevailing wind directions at Shanghai and Hongkong. This is weather data, and the entries are directional text rather than quantities.
review_questions: Wind directions are expressed as compass bearings with angles (e.g. N. 9° W.); should this be treated as a statistical table rather than a text table?

tables.title: Capital Invested in Principal Coal Mines, 1924.
tables.rationale: Capital invested in the principal coal mines is listed by mine, with nationality of ownership and date of establishment. The subjects are coal mining and investment.
review_questions: Should the mine ownership by nationality be tagged foreign-investment or companies? The mixed Chinese and foreign ownership is only partly stated.

tables.title: [Imports and Exports of Iron, 1920-1924]
tables.rationale: Tonnages of iron imports and exports for 1920-1924 are customs trade figures.
review_questions: The material is not specified as ore, pig iron or manufactured iron; iron-and-steel is the closest tag.

tables.title: [Composition of Yunnan Tin According to London Metal Exchange]
tables.rationale: Percentage chemical composition of refined Yunnan tin and its impurities.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for metal composition or quality grades?

tables.title: [Shuik'oushan Mine Concentrated Ore Production, 1912–1921]
tables.rationale: Concentrated zinc and lead ore production at the Shuik'oushan mine, plus a minor sulphur column.
review_questions: Sulphur has no dedicated tag; propose one if needed.

tables.title: [Mercury Export Statistics, 1919–1924]
tables.rationale: Original mercury export tonnages, 1919-1924; the context links this to production, but the figures are exports.
review_questions: No mercury tag exists in the vocabulary; propose one.

tables.title: [Yu Seng Co. Output]
tables.rationale: Annual output of the Yu Seng Co., 1918-1923. The product is not identified in the record, so no mineral tag is supported.
review_questions: Which mineral does the Yu Seng Co. produce? The chapter heading suggests molybdenum, bismuth, arsenic or petroleum, but none is stated in the record.

tables.title: [Molybdenum Export]
tables.rationale: Molybdenum ore exports in tons per customs figures; trade with exports. No molybdenum tag exists, and the mining topic covers the mineral.
review_questions: Propose a tag for molybdenum or minor metals.

tables.title: [Bismuth Export]
tables.rationale: Bismuth ore exports in tons from customs reports; export series.
review_questions: Propose a bismuth tag.

tables.title: [Arsenic Export From Hankow]
tables.rationale: Arsenic exports from Hankow in tons per customs returns; export series.
review_questions: Propose an arsenic tag.

tables.title: [Orpiment and Realgar Export]
tables.rationale: Total exports of orpiment and realgar in tons, mainly via Tengyueh; export series.
review_questions: Propose a tag for arsenic minerals such as orpiment and realgar.

tables.title: [Talc and Magnesite Production]
tables.rationale: Output of talc and magnesite in tons, 1920-1923, a two-mineral extraction summary.
review_questions: Propose tags for talc and magnesite.

tables.title: Manufactured Asbestos
tables.rationale: Yearly production of manufactured asbestos articles by the Tientsin Company in catties; a manufactured product, not extraction.
review_questions: No existing tag fits asbestos goods; propose an asbestos or building-materials tag.

tables.title: [Cephalic Index Percentages of the Living Population of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Percentages of cephalic-index types among 1187 living people of China proper. This is a physical-anthropology measurement of the population. No vocabulary tag covers anthropometry or race measurement.
review_questions: Propose a tag for physical anthropology or anthropometric characteristics.

tables.title: Peking-Mukden (Kin-Feng) Railway
tables.rationale: Capital and invested surplus of the Peking-Mukden Railway: government capital, British and Japanese loan balances and accumulated surplus revenue. This is a financial account of a railway company; no existing tag fits railway capital accounts. Foreign loans are only components of the capital, not the table's subject, so no tag is assigned.
review_questions: Consider a tag for railway capital and finance accounts.

tables.title: Dimensions of Principal Bridges
tables.rationale: Principal railway bridge dimensions by locality, span arrangement and truss type; railway infrastructure. roads-and-bridges is for road/bridge works, not railway-only assets.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a railway-bridge or rail-infrastructure tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Dimensions of Principal Bridges
tables.rationale: Railway bridge span numbers and lengths between stations; railway infrastructure.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a railway-bridge or rail-infrastructure tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Dimensions of Principal Tunnels
tables.rationale: Railway tunnel lengths between named stations on the Antung-Mukden line; railway infrastructure.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a railway-tunnel or rail-infrastructure tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Principal Roads]
tables.rationale: Inventory of principal roads in Chihli and nearby provinces: termini, condition, builder. Content is mainly textual with some lengths; builders include American Red Cross and the famine relief commission.
review_questions: Mixed table: lengths are only partially given and are secondary to the route descriptions; is the text-tables flag appropriate?

tables.title: Income and Expenditure, 1914-24.
tables.rationale: Chinese Post Office income, working expenditure, surplus and capital expenditure by year. No vocabulary tag fits postal operating accounts.
review_questions: Propose a tag for postal finances or postal accounts.

tables.title: [Foreign Postal Agencies Closed in China, 1922]
tables.rationale: Foreign postal agencies in China closed in 1922, by nationality and closure date. This reflects foreign privileges in the postal sector.
review_questions: Propose a tag for foreign post offices in China.

tables.title: Tariff for Domestic Telegrams
tables.rationale: Per-word domestic telegram rates by destination and language; telegraph tariffs.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a communications tariff/charges tag; telegraph used for the service.

tables.title: Wireless Stations in Operation or Under Construction in China
tables.rationale: Inventory of wireless stations with ranges, power, wavelengths, ownership and controlling authority; mixed quantitative and descriptive content. Radiotelegraph is within radio/telegraph. Many are foreign-controlled, but the table is primarily a technical station list.
review_questions: Does foreign military control of stations justify an informal-imperialism or foreign-garrisons label?

tables.title: [Appropriations of the China Foundation to Institutions and Projects]
tables.rationale: China Foundation appropriations to institutions and educational or research projects, with sub-totals and grand total.
review_questions: Should a vocabulary term for philanthropic foundations or research funding be added?

tables.title: Enrolment of Women Students
tables.rationale: Women students enrolled at mission colleges by institution type; the subject is mission higher education.
review_questions: Is a tag for women's education needed? women-workers was not applied because it concerns employment.

tables.title: Wine and Tobacco Taxes Collected for the Year 1921.
tables.rationale: Wine and tobacco tax collections by district, split into monopoly fee, tax and licence fee, with several yearly sets.
review_questions: The record has three unlabelled blocks, apparently for different years, though the title says 1921.

tables.title: Stamp Revenue Collected by the Provinces, 1922-1924
tables.rationale: Stamp revenue collected by province, 1922-1924; a tax revenue table.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no specific stamp-tax tag; taxation is the closest fit.

tables.title: Inadequately Secured Foreign Loans Classified According to Country
tables.rationale: Itemised inadequately secured foreign loans with creditor, amounts, interest rates, security and outstanding balances at 31 December 1925.
review_questions: The title says classified by country, but the transcription shows creditors of several countries.

tables.title: Table A.—Summary of Secured Obligations
tables.rationale: Summary of secured Ministry of Communications obligations (railway, telegraph, telephone loans, materials) with unpaid principal and arrears; largely foreign-currency loans.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for government ministry or railway debts generally; domestic debt not covered.

tables.title: Telegraph Obligations on Materials. Table B. Summary 6.
tables.rationale: Telephone materials obligations owed to suppliers (China-Japan Industrial Development Co., China Electric Co.), with unpaid principal and arrears; these are supplier credits rather than clearly loans.
review_questions: Should a tag for supplier credit or ministry obligations be added? public-debt and foreign-loans are not clearly supported.

tables.title: [Rates of Conversion into Chinese Dollars]
tables.rationale: Fixed conversion rates of foreign currencies and taels into Chinese dollars used for calculating the Ministry's debts.
review_questions: foreign-exchange denotes market rates; these are fixed accounting conversion rates, so no tag assigned.

tables.title: [National Loan Service — Boxer Indemnity, Grand Total (continued from previous page)]
tables.rationale: Grand total of loan service accounts split into paid-off and outstanding amounts, with remarks on coupons and exchange.
review_questions: The heading refers to the Boxer Indemnity, but the row is a generic grand total of loan accounts; is indemnities appropriate?

tables.title: Names of Inadequately Secured Foreign Loans and Dates of Contraction and Default
tables.rationale: Japanese loans to China in default with outstanding amounts, dates and creditors. Foreign loans are the main subject. Foreign financial control is plausible but not explicit.
review_questions: Is informal-imperialism supported without explicit control or privilege content?

tables.title: [Copper-Cent Exchange Rates, 1912–1925]
tables.rationale: Copper-cents per dollar at Shanghai, 1912-1925, show depreciation of the copper currency against the dollar. The rate is an exchange rate between two coins within one monetary system.
review_questions: The foreign-exchange tag was not used because the rates compare domestic coin denominations rather than foreign currencies; confirm.

tables.title: Imports and Exports of Bar Silver and Sycee, 1892-1924
tables.rationale: Customs totals of silver bar and sycee imports and exports, 1892-1924, are a bullion trade series with net imports. No silver tag fits because silver here is bullion trade tied to currency use, not mining or a commodity-output table.

tables.title: Movement of Silver Bars to and from Shanghai during the Four Years Ended 1925
tables.rationale: Sources of silver bars reaching Shanghai over four years (imports from the U.S.A., London and Eastern ports) form a bullion import table.
review_questions: Should the silver tag cover bullion trade as well as mining and commodity data?

tables.title: Import and Export of Gold, Silver and Merchandise, 1915 to 1924
tables.rationale: Annual imports, exports and net flows of gold, silver and merchandise in Haikwan taels, 1915-1924. The table is a trade-balance account for treasure and merchandise.
review_questions: Silver trade has no dedicated trade tag; the silver tag covers mined silver and bullion and was not added.

tables.title: Native Interest and Copper Exchange.
tables.rationale: Sample Shanghai Native Bank Bourse bulletin with morning and afternoon quotations for native interest, dollars, cents and coppers. These are currency exchange quotations, with an interest-rate item.
review_questions: Should a tag for native bank bourse quotations be proposed?

tables.title: Commemoration Days of the Republic
tables.rationale: Textual list of Republic of China commemoration days with dates and events; no statistical quantities. Not a dedicated chronology of general history, but it is a list of political anniversaries.
review_questions: Should a tag for public holidays or commemorations be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: [Increases in Assessment Valuation, 1924]
tables.rationale: Increases in assessment valuation by district for rating purposes; this relates to the rates tax base.
review_questions: Is a rating/property-tax-specific tag needed?

tables.title: [Rateable Value of Hongkong Districts]
tables.rationale: Rateable value by district, the base for property rates, so taxation is the closest fit.
review_questions: Is a rating/property-tax-specific tag needed?

tables.title: [Principal Sources of Revenue and Expenditure, Settlement Continued from Previous Page]
tables.rationale: Continued revenue sources and 1925 ordinary and extraordinary expenditures of a foreign concession in taels.
review_questions: The concession is not named in this record; confirm it is a foreign concession from the preceding page.

tables.title: [Finances of Foreign Settlements and Concessions, 1925]
tables.rationale: Summary finances (debentures, revenue, sources, expenditure) of a foreign settlement or concession in 1925.
review_questions: The entry is untitled as to the specific concession; confirm which one it describes.

tables.title: Anglo-Chinese Calendar, 1925
tables.rationale: Anglo-Chinese calendar for 1925 mapping Gregorian months and days to Chinese lunar months and intercalary markers; a calendar conversion. Tabulated day ranges are structural, not substantive quantities.
review_questions: Should calendar tables sit under a topic other than history, such as science-and-technology?

review_questions: Cocaine has no dedicated tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Customs Seizures of Narcotics at Tsingtao, 1925
tables.rationale: Customs seizures of heroin and cocaine at Tsingtao in 1925, quantities in ounces.
review_questions: Cocaine has no dedicated tag.

tables.title: Caffeine Imported Into Shanghai with Countries of Origin
tables.rationale: Caffeine imports into Shanghai by country of origin in pounds for 1923 and 1924, documenting the drug trade.
review_questions: Caffeine has no dedicated tag; consider proposing a drug/chemical tag.

tables.title: Strychnine Imported Into Shanghai with Countries of Origin
tables.rationale: Strychnine imports into Shanghai by country of origin in pounds for 1923 and 1924, linked to anti-opium pills.
review_questions: Strychnine has no dedicated tag.

tables.title: Seizures of Narcotic Drugs by Maritime Customs at the Ports of Shanghai, Tientsin and Tsingtao, during, 1925
tables.rationale: Maritime Customs seizures of heroin, cocaine and morphia in 1925, listed by quantity, vessel and manufacturer.
review_questions: Cocaine has no dedicated tag.

tables.title: Shanghai
tables.rationale: Narcotic seizures at Shanghai by drug, ounces, vessel, origin and manufacturer.
review_questions: Cocaine has no dedicated tag.

tables.title: Tsingtao
tables.rationale: Narcotic seizures at Tsingtao of heroin and cocaine by ounces, vessel, label and manufacturer.
review_questions: Cocaine has no dedicated tag.

tables.rationale: Narcotic seizures totalled by port and by drug (morphia, heroin, cocaine) in ounces; seizures are suppression results, and morphia and heroin are named substances.
review_questions: Cocaine has no dedicated tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Exports of Flour
tables.rationale: Table of flour export quantities and values for 1923 and 1924. Flour is a wheat product, but no dedicated flour tag exists, so wheat is the nearest fit.
review_questions: Should a flour or flour-milling tag be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: [Trade for 1923]
tables.rationale: Silk trade quantities and values by category (raw silk, cocoons, waste) for 1923; cocoons are included but the main subject is silk trade. The silk and cocoon categories are listed without import/export labels in the transcription.

tables.title: Exports of Vegetable Tallow
tables.rationale: Export quantity and value of vegetable tallow at Swatow; no specific tag exists for vegetable tallow.

review_questions: Should a tag for local property rates or valuation be added? The taxation tag covers assessment but this table has no tax receipts or rates.

tables.title: [Settlement of Strikes in Shanghai]
tables.rationale: Counts strikes by manner of settlement, such as demands accepted or rejected, lockout, or promises to investigate. Mediation-and-arbitration is a possible fit, but only loosely, since the categories mostly describe outcomes.
review_questions: Does the settlement outcome classification justify mediation-and-arbitration?

tables.title: Commemoration Days of the Republic
tables.rationale: Short list of Republic commemoration dates and the events they mark; textual. No existing tag covers public holidays or commemorations.
review_questions: Propose a tag for public holidays and commemorations.

tables.title: Anglo-Chinese Calendar, 1928 — October (VIII–IX Moons)
tables.rationale: Day-by-day concordance of Gregorian dates, Chinese lunar days, moons and weekdays; a calendar conversion table. Lunar-day numbers are calendrical, but the table is a structured concordance rather than narrative text.
review_questions: Topic 'history' is the closest high-level fit for calendar conversion; is a dedicated calendar topic needed?

tables.title: Anglo-Chinese Calendar, 1928 — September (VII–VIII Moons)
tables.rationale: Concordance of September 1928 Gregorian dates with Chinese lunar days, moons and weekdays.
review_questions: Topic 'history' is the closest high-level fit for calendar conversion; is a dedicated calendar topic needed?

tables.title: Anglo-Chinese Calendar, 1928 — August (VI–VII Moons)
tables.rationale: Concordance of August 1928 Gregorian dates with Chinese lunar days, moons and weekdays.
review_questions: Topic 'history' is the closest high-level fit for calendar conversion; is a dedicated calendar topic needed?

tables.title: Anglo-Chinese Calendar, 1928 — July (V–VI Moons)
tables.rationale: Concordance of July 1928 Gregorian dates with Chinese lunar days, moons and weekdays.
review_questions: Topic 'history' is the closest high-level fit for calendar conversion; is a dedicated calendar topic needed?

tables.title: [Companies in Which Union Insurance Society Holds a Majority Interest]
tables.rationale: Paid-up capital and total funds of five insurance companies in which the Union Insurance Society holds a majority interest.
review_questions: Currency signs for the Far Eastern Insurance Co. are unreadable in the transcription.

tables.title: Far Eastern Insurance Companies — Life Insurance
tables.rationale: Three insurance companies with founding date, head office, business scope, capital, funds and 1926 net premium income.
review_questions: Paid-up capital for China Underwriters is unreadable.

tables.title: Foreign Advisers to the Government of China
tables.rationale: List of foreign advisers employed by Chinese government offices, with nationality and position. It is a textual roster of officeholders. Nationality is a label on individuals, not a population breakdown.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for foreign advisers as a form of foreign influence on a nominally sovereign state? No existing tag covers it.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: Glossary of Chinese military terms with characters and romanisation. It is textual reference content covering offices, branches and units.
review_questions: Propose a vocabulary term for military terminology or glossaries.

tables.title: [Types of Military Organizations Under Which Armed Men Classify Themselves]
tables.rationale: Text list of irregular and semi-military organisation names with English equivalents, such as guards, constabulary and bandit suppression units. No single existing tag covers this mixed set.
review_questions: Propose a tag for irregular or local armed forces and military terminology.

tables.title: Yunnanese Army
tables.rationale: Yunnanese army brigades, troops, guns, and aircraft strengths and locations; mainly land forces.
review_questions: Should the small air force row justify an air-force tag?

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers
tables.rationale: Strength of Shanghai Volunteer Corps units by nationality of company, in the foreign-run settlement; no tag covers volunteer or militia forces.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer corps or militia.

tables.title: Chinese Naval Yards
tables.rationale: Naval dockyards with locations, repair facilities and dry-dock dimensions (measurements); a statistical table about naval yards.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for naval dockyards/repair facilities; navy used as nearest fit.

tables.title: Also Sole Agents For:—
tables.rationale: Advertisement listing firms and the products they supply (sole agencies); textual, with no quantities. Commercial company-product listing.
review_questions: Is an advertisement page better handled by a dedicated advertising or non-table classification?

tables.title: [Contributors acknowledged in the Preface]
tables.rationale: Preface list of contributors and the subjects they wrote; textual acknowledgements with no statistical content. No existing tag fits the publication's own editorial credits.
review_questions: Propose a tag for book front matter or editorial credits.

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)
tables.rationale: Nautical distance matrices between ports and places; the figures are distances, not areas, physical features or traffic. No suitable detailed tag exists.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distances and routes.

tables.title: [The chief lakes of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Chief lakes of China Proper with dimensions, areas and altitudes; lakes connected to waterways.
review_questions: Lakes lack a dedicated tag; rivers-and-waterways covers connected lakes but may be approximate.

tables.title: [Synoptic table of the Cenozoic history of China]
tables.rationale: Synoptic table of Cenozoic geological formations, lithology, fossils and distribution; textual geology.
review_questions: Geology/palaeontology has no dedicated tag; consider proposing 'geology'.

tables.title: [Known localities of alkaline igneous rocks in China]
tables.rationale: Textual list of localities of alkaline igneous rocks in China; geological description.
review_questions: Consider proposing a 'geology' tag.

tables.title: [Great epochs of tectonic movements and igneous activities in China]
tables.rationale: Textual summary of geological epochs of tectonic movement and igneous activity; geological description.
review_questions: Consider proposing a 'geology' tag.

tables.title: [Cephalic indices of the living population of China proper]
tables.rationale: Percentages of head-shape types (cephalic indices) among 1187 living people of China proper; anthropometric characteristics of the population.
review_questions: No tag covers physical anthropology; propose 'physical-anthropology'.

tables.title: [Tentative conclusions regarding the physical traits of the Chinese]
tables.rationale: Textual conclusions about physical traits of the Chinese from anthropometric data; narrative, not quantities.
review_questions: No tag covers physical anthropology; propose 'physical-anthropology'.

tables.title: [Rulers of the Manchu dynasty]
tables.rationale: List of Manchu dynasty rulers with reign years; textual roster with incidental dates. No tag fits for a ruler list (imperial-household concerns court/household, not reign lists).
review_questions: Consider a vocabulary term for rulers and dynastic lists.

tables.title: [Examples of Mongol and Manchu words]
tables.rationale: Examples of Mongol and Manchu words with meanings; textual illustration of languages, not statistics.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term for linguistics or word lists needed?

tables.title: Totals for Ten Months Ending October 31, 1925-6-7
tables.rationale: British Lancashire piece-goods trade to China by cloth class in square yards (grey, bleached, printed, dyed, coloured). Cotton goods are inferred from the piece-goods heading; textiles is the general tag.
review_questions: Piece-goods are not explicitly identified as cotton in the table; the cotton tag rests on Lancashire piece-goods usage.

tables.title: [Japanese investments in China]
tables.rationale: Japanese investments in China and Manchuria by sector, in yen.
review_questions: Printed Manchuria total does not reconcile with its components.

tables.title: [Places open to trade: C. Ports of Call]
tables.rationale: Ports of call on Yangtze and West River stages for passengers and cargo, with treaty authority; textual list.
review_questions: Is a river-stage or ports-of-call tag needed? Inland-navigation could fit but is not clearly about operations.

tables.title: Exports [Bristles]
tables.rationale: Bristle export amount and value for 1925-27. No bristle-specific tag exists.
review_questions: Propose a tag for bristles/animal by-products.

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Bone export quantity and value, 1925-27. No bone-specific tag exists.
review_questions: Propose a tag for bones/animal by-products.

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of fresh, dried and cuttle fish by year. Subject is export trade; no tag fits fish products as traded goods (fishing tag is for capture fisheries).
review_questions: Consider a vocabulary term for fish products trade or fish processing.

tables.title: [Medicines and allied products of China]
tables.rationale: A list of medicinal and allied products of China (alum, musk, rhubarb etc.) with no quantities; a textual product inventory. Fits trade/products loosely.
review_questions: Consider a tag for medicinal products or materia medica; pharmaceuticals may not fit raw natural products.

tables.title: Exports 1925 [–1927: medicines and allied products]
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of medicinal products (musk, nutgalls, liquorice, ginger, camphor, cassia) 1925-27. No single tag covers the mixed medicinal commodities.
review_questions: Consider a tag for medicinal products trade.

tables.title: Vermicelli and Macaroni
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of vermicelli and macaroni by year; no specific tag for noodle products.
review_questions: Consider a tag for noodles or pasta; food-processing is not clearly evidenced.

tables.title: Exports of Vegetable Tallow
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of vegetable tallow by year.
review_questions: Consider a tag for vegetable tallow and waxes.

tables.title: Exports of Wax, Vegetable
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of vegetable wax by year.
review_questions: Consider a tag for vegetable tallow and waxes.

tables.title: Export of Strawbraid
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of mottled and white strawbraid by year.
review_questions: Consider a tag for straw braid or handicraft exports.

tables.title: Exports, 1925 [–1927: walnuts]
tables.rationale: Export quantities and values of walnuts in shell and kernels, 1925-1927. Walnuts are tree nuts, not clearly oilseeds, so no commodity tag is assigned.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no tag for tree nuts or walnuts; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Exports of carpets and rugs, 1925–1927]
tables.rationale: Export pieces and values of carpets and rugs by year, 1925-1927. No tag fits carpets exactly.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for carpets and rugs; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Subjects of the entrance examination, Judicial Officers' Training School]
tables.rationale: List of entrance-examination subjects for the Judicial Officers' Training School; textual numbered list. No existing tag fits judicial officer training exactly.
review_questions: Propose a tag for legal or judicial training (judicial officers' training).

tables.title: [Curriculum of the Judicial Officers' Training School]
tables.rationale: Textual list of courses in the Judicial Officers' Training School curriculum; no statistics. No existing tag fits legal professional training.
review_questions: Propose a tag for legal or judicial training (judicial officers' training).

tables.title: [Kwangchouwan government and services]
tables.rationale: Textual directory of Kwangchouwan officials and services (governor, police, medical, education, post, banks). Content is descriptive text with few quantities (500 guards, one company). No single detailed tag fits the multi-function list; colonial-administration is not clearly established as the subject beyond a directory of offices.
review_questions: Should a French leased-territory administration directory receive colonial-rule/colonial-administration? Proposed: a tag for leased-territory administration.

tables.title: [Governmental groups in China and their territorial control, early 1928]
tables.rationale: Textual outline of rival governmental groups and the provinces they controlled in 1928. No existing tag covers political factions or warlord territorial control.
review_questions: Propose a tag for regional political and military factions/warlord control.

tables.title: [Persons present at the Disbandment Conference, January 15, 1929]
tables.rationale: Names of persons present at the Disbandment Conference of January 1929; a participant list. Disbandment of armies is the subject, but only names are listed.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no tag for political conferences or party congresses; propose one?

tables.title: The China Year Book: Special Prices for Former Issues
tables.rationale: Advertisement of prices for former issues of the China Year Book, a book publication sales offer.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for book sales or publisher advertisements; books tag is approximate.

tables.title: [The Asiatic Petroleum Co. (North China) Ltd.: products imported and distributed]
tables.rationale: Advertisement listing petroleum and related products imported and distributed by a company; textual product list without quantities.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term for company product listings needed?

tables.title: [Situation of mission hospitals in China, 1927]
tables.rationale: Status of mission hospitals in 1927 under Southern and Northern governments, with counts and percentages (normal, temporary, seized, closed).
review_questions: Mission hospitals could fit a missions tag but the table is about hospital operating status, so none was added.

tables.title: [Initial measures of the Ministry of Health]
tables.rationale: Textual list of initial measures of the Ministry of Health (national board, laboratory, health officer training, maritime quarantine). Mixed items, none dominant enough for a single tag.
review_questions: Would a health-administration tag be proposed for public health policy lists?

tables.title: Proportion Borne by the Share of Each Nationality to the Whole Trade, 1927
tables.rationale: Percentage shares by flag of tonnage, foreign and coast trade, and customs revenue (duties and tonnage dues). Mixes trade, shipping and revenue shares by nationality of vessel; no single tag fits all without forcing one component.
review_questions: Consider a tag for carrying trade by flag/nationality of shipping.

tables.title: [Mongols outside Mongolia]
tables.rationale: Textual enumeration of Mongol groups outside Mongolia with the authorities supervising them; mostly ethnic and administrative description. No existing tag fits well.
review_questions: Is a tag for Mongol banners and tribal groups needed?

tables.title: [Shanghai Harbour: dry docks]
tables.rationale: Dimensions of Shanghai dry docks; port facilities.
review_questions: Dry docks relate to shipbuilding and repair, but this table covers only dock dimensions, so shipbuilding is not assigned.

tables.title: [Shanghai Harbour: pilotage tariff of fees]
tables.rationale: Pilotage tariff by route per foot and per ton at Shanghai.
review_questions: Pilotage is a navigation service; navigation-aids is not a clear fit, so it is not assigned.

tables.title: [Yangtze River Commission: Technical Committee members, 1922]
tables.rationale: A list of seven Technical Committee members of the Yangtze River Commission with a chairman; the content is purely textual personnel. No existing tag covers river commission membership precisely.
review_questions: Consider a tag for river commission organisation or personnel.

tables.title: [Yangtze River Commission: personnel of the new Technical Committee]
tables.rationale: A roster of the new Yangtze River Commission Technical Committee with advisers noted. The content is textual personnel for a river conservancy body.
review_questions: Consider a tag for river commission organisation or personnel.

tables.title: [Swatow Harbour: particulars]
tables.rationale: Swatow harbour particulars, largely descriptive text with some depths, berths and charges.
review_questions: Mixed descriptive and numeric content; the text-tables flag is a judgement call.

tables.title: [Copper cents exchanged for one dollar at Shanghai, 1912-1928]
tables.rationale: Copper cents exchanged per dollar at Shanghai, year-end quotations 1912-1928; a conversion rate between monetary units.
review_questions: Is a domestic coin-to-dollar exchange rate better covered by currency than foreign-exchange?

tables.title: [Ratio of loss on conversion of copper-cent income into dollars, Shanghai Tramways, 1909-1928]
tables.rationale: Ratio of loss on converting copper-cent income into dollars for Shanghai Tramways; a company's monetary conversion loss. Tram content is incidental, and no existing tag fits the subject.
review_questions: Propose a tag for currency-conversion losses of a company, or confirm currency-related coverage.

tables.title: Shanghai Official T. T. Quotations. (1928)
tables.rationale: Monthly high and low Shanghai official T.T. quotations for sterling and other currencies in 1928, alongside bar silver and gold bar prices.
review_questions: Is a tag for precious-metal market prices needed for bar silver and gold bar quotations?

tables.title: Import and Export of Gold, Silver and Merchandise, 1916 to 1927
tables.rationale: Imports, exports and net movements of gold, silver and merchandise in Haikwan taels, 1918-1927. Gold and silver are treasure flows compared with merchandise trade.
review_questions: Would a treasure or bullion movements tag be better than separate gold and silver tags?

tables.title: Treasure Imported from and Exported to Foreign Countries during 1927
tables.rationale: Treasure (gold, silver and copper coins) imported and exported in 1927 by country, with gold and silver both substantial.
review_questions: Would a treasure movements tag fit better?

tables.title: Time Required to Travel from Each Province to Nanking
tables.rationale: Travel time and distance from provincial capitals to Nanking, present versus future via planned railway lines. It is a transport accessibility comparison.
review_questions: Travel-time or accessibility comparisons have no dedicated tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: Lines under Contract
tables.rationale: Railway lines under contract, with state of scheme and approximate mileage. Content is mostly descriptive text on concessions and foreign loan agreements. Foreign concessions are explicit.
review_questions: Railway concession and contract terms have no dedicated tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Liabilities during 1928, including amount unpaid in 1926]
tables.rationale: Annual principal and interest liabilities on mortgage bonds of the Tao-Chin Railway; financial obligations of a railway. Evidence does not clearly establish foreign loans or public debt.
review_questions: Should a railway-debt or railway-finance tag be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: [Other liabilities not specified]
tables.rationale: Other liabilities of the Tao-Chin Railway: gold loan, rolling stock loan and unpaid wages, converted from sterling to dollars. Railway accounts.
review_questions: Should a railway-debt or railway-finance tag be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Dimensions of Principal Bridges
tables.rationale: Lengths and spans of principal railway bridges on the Shantung railway; quantitative dimensions of railway infrastructure. The roads-and-bridges tag is not used since the bridges are tabulated only as railway assets.
review_questions: Should a railway-infrastructure or bridge-engineering tag be added?

tables.title: Construction Begun
tables.rationale: Dates, gauges and builders of South Manchuria Railway construction; the foreign-concession heading does not by itself establish a concession-system subject.
review_questions: Should informal-imperialism be added given the 'Foreign Concessions' section heading?

tables.title: Locomotives
tables.rationale: Locomotive and motor coach stock of the Kowloon-Canton Railway by type, weight and maker.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for rolling stock; railways used as the closest fit.

tables.title: Locomotives
tables.rationale: Locomotive inventory of the Chinese Eastern Railway by wheel arrangement, weight, tractive power and maker, with totals.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a rolling-stock tag.

tables.title: Locomotives
tables.rationale: Locomotive stock of the Yunnan Railway by type, wheels, weight and maker.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a rolling-stock tag.

tables.title: Locomotives
tables.rationale: Locomotive stock of the Canton-Hankow Railway southern section by type, wheels, weight and maker.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a rolling-stock tag.

tables.title: [Nationalities of foreign employees of the Chinese Post Office]
tables.rationale: List of nationalities of foreign Post Office employees with no counts; textual list.
review_questions: Should nationality-and-ethnicity apply to a bare list of staff nationalities without figures?

tables.title: Income and Expenditure, 1924-1927
tables.rationale: Post office income, working expenditure, surplus and capital expenditure by year. This is a postal operating account, and no vocabulary tag covers it.
review_questions: Should a tag for postal finance or public enterprise accounts be added?

tables.title: [Closure of foreign postal agencies in China]
tables.rationale: Foreign postal agencies in China (British, French, American, Japanese) closed after the Washington Conference, with counts and closure dates. This shows foreign privileges ending; the postal-service tag is not used.
review_questions: Should a tag for foreign postal agencies or privileges be added?

tables.title: [Programme of studies in elementary schools (1922): percentage of time devoted to each subject]
tables.rationale: Percentage of time per subject in lower and higher primary school programmes.
review_questions: Curriculum content has no dedicated tag; consider proposing 'curriculum'.

tables.title: [Programme (1920) for enforcing compulsory education by type of community]
tables.rationale: Schedule of years for enforcing compulsory elementary education by community type. The content is textual, with years only as dates.
review_questions: Consider a tag for compulsory education policy.

tables.title: [Required courses of study for the junior middle school]
tables.rationale: Required course credits by subject for the junior middle school, with a total.
review_questions: Curriculum content has no dedicated tag; consider proposing 'curriculum'.

tables.title: [Senior middle school courses: general department]
tables.rationale: Credit requirements for the senior middle school general-department courses (Arts and Social Science; Mathematics and Natural Science). The subject is secondary school curriculum.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no curriculum/courses tag.

tables.title: [Curriculum of the regular three-year normal course]
tables.rationale: Credits by subject group in the regular three-year normal course, which is teacher-training curriculum.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no curriculum tag.

tables.title: [Institutions of the Association of Christian Colleges and Universities in China]
tables.rationale: List of institutions and places in the Association of Christian Colleges and Universities, i.e. missionary higher education.
review_questions: Mission-school tag was not applied; confirm whether Christian colleges fit it.

tables.title: Profit per Man-work Unit for All Crops
tables.rationale: Profit per man-work unit by crop in Weihsien farming, comparing several crops; peasant labour returns.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a farm-profitability or farm-costs tag.

tables.title: A Comparison of Profits per Man-work Unit for Different One Year Cropping Systems
tables.rationale: Profit per man-work unit by one-year cropping system, covering several crops.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a farm-profitability or farm-costs tag.

tables.title: Semi-Monthly Distribution of Total Man Labour by Hours for All Crops
tables.rationale: Semi-monthly man-labour hours across several crops (wheat, cotton, soybeans, kaoliang, millet, sweet potatoes, tobacco) on a Shantung farm survey; a statistical table of farm labour by crop.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for farm labour inputs or peasant labour time; crop-production is an approximate fit.

tables.title: Semi-Monthly Distribution of Man Labour by Hours per Mow for All Crops
tables.rationale: Man-labour hours per mow by half-month for six crops in Weihsien; statistical farm labour table organised by crop.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm labour input or peasant labour time.

tables.title: Distribution of Farms
tables.rationale: Counts of surveyed farms by town on the Chengtu Plain; a sample distribution, not tenure or production. No existing tag covers farm survey sampling.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm surveys or sample distribution.

tables.title: Labour Costs and Income
tables.rationale: Paid and unpaid labour costs and income from labour for renters, part-owners and owners on surveyed farms. Costs of farm labour are not wages in a standard sense and no tag fits well.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm labour costs or farm income; wages is a doubtful fit as it mixes paid and unpaid labour.

tables.title: [Members of the China Indemnity Advisory Committee (Great Britain)]
tables.rationale: Roster of the British and Chinese members of the China Indemnity Advisory Committee, with honours and career particulars; text content only.
review_questions: Is a tag for advisory or commission membership needed?

tables.title: [Members of the Consortium]
tables.rationale: Roster of member banks of the American, British, French and Japanese groups of the international banking Consortium for China. It is a text list. Foreign-loans is the nearest fit, but no loan amounts are given.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for international financial consortia or foreign banks?

tables.title: Independent Educational Administrations
tables.rationale: Officials of the National Research Institute and the university districts, independent educational administrations; a textual roster of office-holders.
review_questions: Is a tag for research or university administration needed? None of the existing tags fits precisely.

tables.title: Special Commissioners for Foreign Affairs
tables.rationale: List of provincial Special Commissioners for Foreign Affairs by province and seat. These are domestic officials handling foreign affairs, not diplomatic missions abroad.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for foreign affairs commissioners or local foreign-affairs offices?

tables.title: Commissioners for Foreign Affairs
tables.rationale: List of Commissioners for Foreign Affairs by place, including Hankow special district directors. It is a roster of officials without a fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for local foreign-affairs commissioners?

tables.title: List of Foreign Advisers
tables.rationale: List of foreign advisers attached to government bodies such as the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Railways and the Nanking municipal government, with positions.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for foreign advisers to the Chinese government?

tables.title: Strength of Infantry Division
tables.rationale: Strength of an infantry division: officers, men, horses, rifles, mortars, machine guns, field guns and wagons.
review_questions: Is a tag for military equipment or force strength needed? The existing arms-and-arsenals tag concerns production and stocks of weapons, so none was assigned beyond army.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: Glossary of English, Chinese and romanized military terms; textual reference list with no quantities.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for glossaries or terminology.

tables.title: [Characteristics of the two-seater Caudron built at the Hsi Hung Chiao Aircraft Workshop]
tables.rationale: Specifications and cost of a two-seater aircraft built at a Chinese aircraft workshop; aviation fits, with a military setting in the Army and Navy chapter. No tag covers aircraft construction specifications.
review_questions: Is the aircraft military or civil? A tag for aircraft manufacture or specifications could be proposed.

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers
tables.rationale: Strength of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps by unit and nationality in the foreign-administered Shanghai settlement. It is a volunteer force, not clearly a regular army, and no tag fits exactly.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer or municipal defence forces.
Is the informal-imperialism topic sufficiently evidenced by the table itself?

tables.title: Chinese Naval Yards
tables.rationale: Naval yards and dry dock dimensions and repair facilities. The navy tag fits; dock facilities have no precise tag.
review_questions: Propose a vocabulary term for docks and shipyard facilities.

tables.title: General Data
tables.rationale: Hull dimensions of U.S. gunboats Guam and Tutuila in the shipbuilding section; these are technical specifications. No tag fits well, since this is neither shipbuilding output nor a fleet count.
review_questions: Should a tag for ship design specifications be added? Is the shipbuilding tag meant to cover this?

tables.title: Principal Dimensions
tables.rationale: Principal dimensions of the Chinese Navy gunboat Hsein Ning in the shipbuilding section; a technical specification of a single vessel.
review_questions: Should a vessel-specification tag be added? Does the military navy tag apply to a single gunboat's build data?

tables.title: [Ordnance of the gunboat Hsein Ning]
tables.rationale: Lists the armament of the gunboat Hsein Ning (guns by number and type), which is naval ordnance.
review_questions: Does the arms-and-arsenals tag cover the armament of a single vessel?

tables.title: Progressive Trials
tables.rationale: Progressive trial results (speed, horsepower, boiler pressure, vacuum, slip, revolutions per minute) for the gunboat Hsein Ning; technical engineering data.
review_questions: Should a tag for ship trials or engineering performance be added?

tables.title: [Coasting and river vessels, by owning company]
tables.rationale: Inventory of coasting and river steamers by owning company, with build year and gross register tonnage; a merchant fleet listing with substantive tonnage figures.
review_questions: Would a dedicated inland-navigation or fleet-inventory tag be useful? Many vessels are river and coasting steamers, but the table mixes ocean-going and Japanese Dairen vessels, so inland-navigation was not assigned.

tables.title: Sea, Coast and River Distances
tables.rationale: Matrix of nautical distances between ports from London to the Far East. No existing tag covers distance tables.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Sea, Coast and River Distances
tables.rationale: Nautical distances between Shanghai, Japanese and Pacific ports, Panama and New York. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Distances (via Siberia)
tables.rationale: Distances via Siberia between European, Manchurian and Chinese places. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Coast Distances—A
tables.rationale: Coast distances between Shanghai and southern ports. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Coast Distances—B
tables.rationale: Coast distances between Shanghai and northern ports. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Origin of Silt
tables.rationale: Shows the percentage of Yangtze silt originating from each sub-basin, a physical characteristic of the river regime.
review_questions: Is a dedicated tag for sediment or silt wanted? Rivers-and-waterways is only an approximate fit.

tables.title: [Cephalic Indices of the Living Population of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Percentage distribution of cephalic index types among the living population of China Proper, a racial-anthropological classification of people as used by the source.
review_questions: Should a physical anthropology or racial-classification tag be added to the vocabulary? Nationality-and-ethnicity is only an approximate fit.

tables.title: [Rulers of the Manchu Dynasty]
tables.rationale: Roster of Manchu Dynasty rulers with reign years. The reign dates are incidental, so the table is textual. No existing detailed tag fits (imperial-household concerns the court and royal family, not a list of reigns).
review_questions: Should a dynastic rulers or reign list tag be added? Existing tags do not fit well.

tables.title: [Bristles — Distribution of Trade by Country, 1929 and 1930]
tables.rationale: Bristle trade distribution by country, in piculs and value. The context describes it as trade distribution, and no specific bristle tag exists.
review_questions: Should a bristles tag be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Bristle export amount and value for 1929 and 1930. No specific bristle tag exists.
review_questions: Should a bristles tag be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Export quantity and value of rice in piculs and Hk. Tls. The context says it is rice exports, though the neighbouring text concerns bone-dust.
review_questions: The title is just 'Exports'. The context identifies rice, but it is placed beside bone-dust discussion; should this be verified against the page?

tables.title: [Mills Operating and Average Daily Output in Manchuria]
tables.rationale: Number of bean-cake mills operating and average daily output by Manchurian district, spring and summer.
review_questions: Is a tag for oil milling or bean-product mills needed? Vegetable-oils is possible but the table covers bean-cake output.

tables.title: Complete List of Cotton Mills in China, December, 1930
tables.rationale: Mill-by-mill list of cotton mills with erection date, location, nationality, capital, and spindles, doublers and looms working and ordered; mixed statistical content.
review_questions: Nationality is a substantial column but the table is an enterprise inventory, so no nationality tag was assigned.

tables.title: Complete List of Cotton Mills in China
tables.rationale: Mill-by-mill inventory of cotton mills with year erected, location, nationality, capital, and spindles and looms working and ordered. Cotton is the subject; capital and ownership are substantial.
review_questions: Spindle and loom figures are partly illegible [?].

tables.title: Complete List of Cotton Mills in China, December, 1930 (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continuation of the cotton mill list with year erected, location, capital and machinery working and ordered.
review_questions: Many machinery figures are unreadable.

tables.title: [Analytical Constants of Tung Oil]
tables.rationale: Analytical constants (specific gravity, acid number, etc.) that tung oil must meet under 1930 inspection regulations; subject is tung oil quality standards.
review_questions: Is a tag for commodity inspection standards needed?

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Exports of medicinal and allied products (cassia, nutgalls, ginseng, musk, medicines, etc.) by quantity and value, 1929 and 1930.
review_questions: Is a tag for medicinal herbs and spices needed? Pharmaceuticals is only an approximate fit.

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Exports of vegetable tallow, vegetable wax and white wax, 1929 and 1930; no fitting commodity tag exists for waxes and tallow.
review_questions: Propose a tag for vegetable wax and tallow.

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Exports of strawbraid by grade in piculs and taels, 1929-30. This is a trade table. No strawbraid-specific tag exists; plant-fibres would be an approximation.
review_questions: Propose a tag for strawbraid or straw products.

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Exports of nuts, in shell and as kernels, in quantity and value for 1929-30. The nuts are treated as oilseeds.
review_questions: The nut type is not specified in the table; is oilseeds the right fit?

tables.title: Exports
tables.rationale: Export pieces and values of carpets and rugs, 1929-30. No carpet or rug tag exists, and textiles is too broad.
review_questions: Propose a tag for carpets and rugs.

tables.title: Suicides and Deaths from Accidents or Violence
tables.rationale: Counts of suicides and deaths from accidents or violence in 1930, split Chinese and non-Chinese. Suicide is named in the title, but the figure is combined with accidental and violent deaths.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for combined accident/violence deaths; the suicide tag is applied because suicide is part of the printed category.

tables.title: Postal Annuities
tables.rationale: Single figure: number of postal annuity subscribers in the Leased Territory. Postal annuities are a postal financial service.
review_questions: Insurance-and-pensions could fit postal annuities, but the postal channel is explicit, so only the postal tag is used.

tables.title: [Local List Expenditure, Continued]
tables.rationale: Continuation of the itemised expenditure list of the local and special accounts with a total; general public expenditure.
review_questions: The printed total is noted as not adding up; figures kept as read.

tables.title: Principal Heads of Expenditure
tables.rationale: Expenditure heads of a foreign concession's municipal government (administration, police, fire brigade, public works, electricity, waterworks). The context line calls it Macao, but the note on the Tientsin Municipal Regulations points to a Tientsin concession; this is a budget table within a concession.
review_questions: Context says Macao, but the footnote and chapter heading suggest a Tientsin concession; confirm which territory.

tables.title: Finances
tables.rationale: Municipal finances for 1930: debt (none), revenue sources and expenditure, within the Tientsin concession account.
review_questions: The table does not say which Tientsin concession it covers; confirm the concession from the surrounding text.

tables.title: [Amoy Cash Balance]
tables.rationale: A single cash balance figure for the Amoy settlement. It has no revenue or expenditure flows, so it is not a public-budget table.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for cash balances or public accounts that are not budget flows?

tables.title: Central Field Health Station
tables.rationale: Budget for the Central Field Health Station covering maintenance, equipment, buildings, hospital and schools; a health-administration budget. No existing tag fits a health-specific budget precisely, and public-budgets would be broad.
review_questions: Propose a tag for health administration budgets or institutions.

tables.title: [Monthly Prevalence of Communicable Diseases — Unnamed Province, Lower Block]
tables.rationale: Lower-block monthly communicable disease status for an unnamed province, December to March.
review_questions: Province is not named in the record; check the source page.

tables.title: [Monthly Prevalence of Certain Communicable Diseases — Yunnan]
tables.rationale: Monthly prevalence codes for nine communicable diseases in a Yunnan block plus a Tientsin block. The coded status series is statistical.
review_questions: The block is labelled Yunnan in the title, but the part is a separate Tientsin block; should the locality labels be verified?

tables.title: Monthly Prevalence of Certain Communicable Diseases by Municipalities, from April, 1930 to March, 1931 (Continued) — Second Municipality (name not visible)
tables.rationale: Monthly prevalence codes for communicable diseases in a municipality whose name is not visible; the table is a continuation.
review_questions: The municipality name is not visible in the transcription.

tables.title: Centigrade and Fahrenheit Temperatures
tables.rationale: Centigrade-Fahrenheit conversion table beside the temperature discussion in the climate chapter. It is a measurement conversion, but its purpose is climatic.
review_questions: Could measurement-and-units be preferred over weather for a pure unit-conversion table?

tables.title: [Output of Lead, Zinc and Pyrite at Shuikoushan]
tables.rationale: Output of lead ore, zinc ore and pyrite at Shuikoushan; lead and zinc are the principal content.
review_questions: Pyrite has no dedicated tag; consider proposing one.

tables.title: [Pyrite Production in Liaoning Province]
tables.rationale: Pyrite output at three Liaoning mines, 1929-1930; no existing tag covers pyrite.
review_questions: Propose a pyrite or sulphur-minerals tag.

tables.title: [Stocks of Silver in Shanghai at End of Each Quarter]
tables.rationale: Quarterly silver stocks held in Shanghai, in taels and dollars. This is a financial/bullion stock measure with no exactly fitting tag; the currency tag is not clearly established.
review_questions: Should a tag for bullion or silver stocks in financial markets be added?

tables.title: [Trade Figures for Wuchow, Nanning, Kiungchow and Pakhoi]
tables.rationale: Trade values for four ports with unlabeled columns; it is unclear whether they are exports or imports, so neither tag is assigned.
review_questions: Are these figures exports, imports or total trade, and which years do the columns cover?

tables.title: Comparative Imports of Metals and Minerals
tables.rationale: Quantities in piculs of imported metals and metal products (iron, steel, copper, tin, lead, aluminium), a trade table. No aggregate metals tag exists, so only imports applies.
review_questions: Consider a tag for metals trade generally.

tables.title: [Imports of Metals and Iron and Steel Products, 1929 and 1930]
tables.rationale: Continuation listing import quantities of iron and steel, lead and tin products for 1929 and 1930.
review_questions: Consider a tag for metals trade generally.

tables.title: [Value of Machinery Imported, 1928–1930]
tables.rationale: Import values of machinery by category (textile, power-station, agricultural etc.) for 1928-1930.
review_questions: Some 1930 values are truncated as printed.

tables.title: [Share of Nations in China's Trade in Electrical Materials and Fittings]
tables.rationale: Import values of electrical materials and fittings by country of origin, 1928-1930.
review_questions: No specific electrical-goods trade tag exists.

tables.title: [Petroleum Imports, 1930]
tables.rationale: Petroleum product imports in 1930 by origin, with direct gross imports, re-exports and net imports.
review_questions: The title does not identify which petroleum product this series covers.

tables.title: [Petroleum Imports, 1930 (Second Series)]
tables.rationale: Second series of 1930 petroleum product imports by origin, with gross, re-export and net lines.
review_questions: The title does not identify which petroleum product this series covers.

tables.title: [Chemical Fertilizers Exported, 1929 and 1930]
tables.rationale: Quantities and values of chemical fertilizers for 1929 and 1930, titled as exported. The context suggests the figures are imports, so the trade direction is unclear and no imports or exports tag is assigned.
review_questions: Title says exported but the chapter is Imports and the context implies imports; which direction is intended?

tables.title: Distribution of Investment Assets, 1927
tables.rationale: Distribution of railway investment assets by construction and financial accounts for several lines in 1927. This is a capital cost accounting of railway property.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for railway capital accounts and assets?

tables.title: Distribution of Investment Assets, 1927 (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continuation of the 1927 railway investment asset distribution, covering construction accounts and financial accounts for further lines.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for railway capital accounts and assets?

tables.title: Distribution of Investment Assets, 1927
tables.rationale: Continuation of the 1927 railway investment asset distribution, including the totals for the Chinese Government Railways.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for railway capital accounts and assets?

tables.title: South Manchuria Railway Company General Balance Sheet — Assets
tables.rationale: Company balance sheet assets of the South Manchuria Railway as at 31 March 1931: fixed assets, investments, current assets, depreciation. Company accounts; the 'companies' tag is meant for corporate organisation and results, but this is a single-company balance sheet with railway, mining and other enterprise assets.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for the accounts or balance sheets of a single company?

tables.title: South Manchuria Railway Company General Balance Sheet — Liabilities
tables.rationale: Liabilities side of the South Manchuria Railway balance sheet showing subscribed capital stock held by the Japanese government and the public, paid up and uncalled.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for company capital stock and shareholding?

tables.title: Liabilities (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continuation of the South Manchuria Railway liabilities: reserves, bonds, current liabilities, deposits and net profit. Corporate accounts.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for the accounts or balance sheets of a single company?

tables.title: Profit and Loss Account
tables.rationale: Profit and loss account of the South Manchuria Railway Company by department: railroad, harbours, collieries, oil distillation, iron works, with income, expenditure and net profit. Company operating accounts.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for the accounts or balance sheets of a single company?

tables.title: Disposition of Net Profit
tables.rationale: Appropriation of a railway's net profit to reserves, dividends on government and public stock, bonuses and balance carried forward. These are company operating accounts. The tag 'companies' is not clearly supported, and the railway is not identified in the record.
review_questions: Which railway is this? The record does not name it. A tag for railway company accounts or dividends may be needed.

tables.title: [Depreciation, Depletion, etc. Charged to Accounts]
tables.rationale: Note showing how the depreciation and depletion charge was allocated between profit and loss and suspense accounts. It is a company accounting item. No existing tag covers it.
review_questions: Should a tag for company accounts or depreciation be proposed?

tables.title: [Popular Makes on the Local Automobile Market]
tables.rationale: Number of cars by make in the two Shanghai settlements; a count of vehicles in use.
review_questions: Is a vehicle-market or car-makes tag needed?

tables.title: Income and Expenditure, 1912—1930
tables.rationale: Post Office income, working expenditure, surplus or deficit and capital expenditure; an operating account of the postal service.
review_questions: No controlled tag for the accounts of a public service; should one be added?

tables.title: [Foreign Postal Agencies Closed in China Under the Washington Conference]
tables.rationale: Foreign postal agencies in China closed under the Washington Conference, by nationality and number: foreign privileges in a nominally sovereign state. Closing dates are partly unreadable but the counts are quantitative.
review_questions: Does a foreign postal agencies tag need adding?

tables.title: Appendix J—Mail Service Maintained to the End of the First Half of the 19th Year, C.H.M.K. (End of June, 1930)
tables.rationale: Mail service line lengths by district and type: courier, steamer, railway, motor and air mail lines, for the Chinese Post Office. The transcription contains two stacked sets of districts, one of them apparently a later period.
review_questions: The record appears to contain two blocks of district rows with two totals; confirm whether they represent different dates.

tables.title: Profit and Loss Account for the First Half-Year, 1930
tables.rationale: Profit and loss account of the Postal Savings Banks, covering interest, exchange and working expenses in two currencies. It is a financial account of a savings institution.
review_questions: Is a tag for bank or institutional accounts needed? None of the existing tags fits a savings bank's own accounts exactly.

tables.title: Wireless Stations in Operation or Under Construction in China (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continuation of the wireless station list with radiotelegraph systems, ranges and power; includes Japanese-controlled stations, but the table is an inventory of stations, not a table on foreign garrisons.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for foreign-controlled wireless stations in the Kwantung Leased Territory and Manchuria?

tables.title: Wireless Stations in Operation or Under Construction
tables.rationale: Wireless stations list includes many stations owned and controlled by Japanese, American, French and British armies, navies and legations in China, giving a foreign-privilege dimension alongside the radiotelegraph inventory.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for foreign-controlled communications installations?

tables.title: [Pilotage Charges at Newchwang]
tables.rationale: Pilotage charges per foot at Newchwang for steam and sailing vessels, inward and outward, are charges for vessel services at a port; the freight and transport costs tag fits.
review_questions: Should a dedicated pilotage tag be added? navigation-aids was not applied because the table is about charges.

tables.title: [Area of Great and Small Harbour, Tsingtao]
tables.rationale: Water areas of the Great and Small Harbours at Tsingtao describe port facilities.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary tag for harbour dimensions or facilities needed?

tables.title: Dry Docks
tables.rationale: Dry dock dimensions (length, breadth, sill depth) at Shanghai are harbour facilities.
review_questions: Should a tag for dry docks or ship repair facilities be added? Shipbuilding covers construction and repair but the table gives only dock dimensions.

tables.title: Record of the Year's Exchange Rates 1931 Shanghai Official T. T. Quotations
tables.rationale: Monthly high and low Shanghai official telegraphic transfer exchange rates on several currencies, with gold bar and bar silver quotations; the transcription has many unreadable cells but the intended quantities are clear.
review_questions: Could a tag for bullion or commodity price quotations (gold bars, bar silver) be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Treasure—Movement of Silver to and from China
tables.rationale: Silver imports and exports (bars, sycee and coin) with net balances, compiled from Maritime Customs statistics. This is a treasure movement series, so it is primarily trade, with finance as secondary.
review_questions: Is there a need for a tag for bullion or treasure movements, especially silver? The existing silver tag is for mining and commodity content.

tables.title: Principal and Interest Secured on the Salt Gabelle, Classified According to Period of Payment
tables.rationale: Principal and interest on foreign loans secured on the salt gabelle, by period of payment, including overdue amounts.
review_questions: Does salt-tax fit a table about loan service secured on salt revenue? Applied tentatively as the best-fitting tag for the salt-revenue security.

tables.title: [Nishihara Loans: Advances Constituting the Main Portion of the Balance]
tables.rationale: Itemised Nishihara loans and advances in yen with a total; these were Japanese loans to China.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for secret or political loans, arms loans?

tables.title: Telegraph Loans Under the Care of the Ministry of Communications
tables.rationale: Lists telegraph loans with amounts issued, interest dates, balances outstanding and redemptions due in 1932; these are foreign loans owed by the Ministry of Communications.
review_questions: Would a tag for telegraph or communications-sector loans be useful?

tables.title: Monthly Payments of Chinese Government Foreign Loans Due in 1931 — Secured on Salt Revenue and Grand Total
tables.rationale: Monthly 1931 payments on foreign loans secured on salt revenue, with grand totals across all security classes.
review_questions: Does salt-revenue security justify the salt-tax tag, or is it only a loan security?

tables.title: General Balance Sheet of the China Foundation for the Promotion of Education and Culture
tables.rationale: Balance sheet of the China Foundation for education and culture, funded from the Boxer Indemnity; assets, endowment funds and liabilities. No tag fits an institutional balance sheet of a foundation.
review_questions: Propose a tag for foundation or endowment accounts.

tables.title: Loans
tables.rationale: Cash and material loans made by the Board of Trustees from the Boxer Indemnity fund to a conservancy board and railways. No tag fits domestic loans from an indemnity fund.
review_questions: Propose a tag for loans made from an indemnity or trust fund.

tables.title: Annual Receipts
tables.rationale: Annual salt revenue receipts 1913-1930 under the Salt Inspectorate; fiscal receipts from salt.
review_questions: Is salt revenue best tagged salt-tax or state-monopolies?

tables.title: [Casualties Found by the Investigations at Pingyang]
tables.rationale: The body counts dead, wounded and missing people; its short context does not establish a military or accidental cause, so no detailed casualty label is forced.
review_questions: The source counts dead, wounded and missing at Pingyang but does not establish the cause. Confirm the appropriate high-level context before adding a detailed casualty term.

tables.title: Number of Lawyers Holding Certificates from the Ministry of Justice
tables.rationale: Licensed lawyers are counted by province; no precise detailed legal-profession tag is available.
review_questions: No approved detailed term covers lawyers or legal professional licensing. Retained without details for later user review.

tables.title: [Cephalic Indices of the Chinese of China Proper]
tables.rationale: The table gives cranial-type percentages; no precise physical-anthropology detailed tag is available.
review_questions: The source reports cephalic indices (physical anthropometry), not an explicit ethnic classification. No precise detailed tag fits.

tables.title: Number of Lawyers Holding Certificates from the Ministry of Justice
tables.rationale: Certified lawyer counts; no approved detailed tag specifically covers the legal profession.
review_questions: No approved detailed term covers lawyers or legal professional licensing. Retained without details for later user review.

tables.title: [Members of the committee of the International Cultural Service of China]
tables.rationale: International cultural service committee roster; no precise approved detailed tag for cultural exchange administration.
review_questions: No approved detailed term precisely covers international cultural exchange administration. Retained without details.

tables.title: Advocate's Licenses Issued by the Ministry of Justice During 1945-1947
tables.rationale: Advocate licences issued; no approved detailed tag specifically covers the legal profession.
review_questions: No approved detailed term covers lawyers or legal professional licensing. Retained without details for later user review.

tables.title: Prewar, Wartime, and Postwar Iron Production
tables.rationale: Iron production totals do not explicitly distinguish ore from smelted iron; leave the detailed tag open for review.
review_questions: Does iron production denote iron ore or smelted iron here? The frozen table does not specify; detailed tags left empty.
